  • Compensation: Competitive pay, between $27 and $35 hourly plus up to a Sign on Bonus of $5,000, based on experience, skill level, and responsibilities.
  • Benefits: Health and dental insurance, paid time off, 401(k) Savings Plan, Flexible Spending Plan, and an Equipment Account.
  • Time Off: Time-off to support your work/life balance
  • Training & Development: Extensive training opportunities, including leadership development and continuing education support in the industry.
  • Tools for Success: Access to industry-leading equipment, climbing gear, and safety-focused crews.
  • Team Environment: Our Tree Care Team works alongside some of the best trained and equipped teams in the industry, with an emphasis on quality and safety.

About SavATree

SavATree was founded 45 years ago with a mission to preserve trees and protect the natural landscapes we all enjoy. Since then, we've grown into a nationwide leader in tree, shrub, and lawn care services.

We're a values-driven organization built on teamwork, integrity, respect, and a shared commitment to the environment. We pride ourselves on offering a collaborative and supportive work culture where your expertise is valued, and your career path is clear. As we like to say: When you work here, you thrive here.

About the Role

As a Tree Climber with SavATree, you’ll be a key member of our General Tree Care Team. This team works on a variety of tree care tasks, including pruning, removals, and cabling. You’ll apply your expertise in climbing, pruning, and safety to ensure the health and beauty of our clients’ landscapes. The Crew Lead position offers additional responsibilities for those who demonstrate leadership qualities and want to guide a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Perform high-quality tree care services, including pruning, removals, and cabling for trees and shrubs
  • Climb trees safely using proper techniques, ropes, saddle, and ladders
  • Operate chainsaws, aerial lifts (bucket trucks), and other tree care equipment effectively
  • Apply ANSI A300 Pruning Standards and ANSI Z safety practices in all tasks
  • Ensure proper pruning cuts and techniques, preserving the health and structure of trees
  • Assist in tree removals and utilize ropes, spikes, and other equipment as needed for safe takedowns
  • Identify hazards and perform safety checks before, during, and after each job
  • Perform aerial rescues if necessary, ensuring safety in high-risk situations
  • Maintain strong communication with team members and clients, ensuring excellent service and safety at all times
  • Take ownership of your role, contributing to a positive, safety-focused team culture

What We’re Looking For

What is Essential:

  • Valid U.S. driver’s license (CDL is a plus)
  • Authorization to work legally in the U.S.
  • Passion for working outdoors and commitment to environmental stewardship

Experience:

  • Proficient in proper pruning techniques for large shade trees and ornamentals
  • Strong knowledge of tree and shrub species, including their characteristics
  • Comfortable climbing without spurs
  • Skilled in adhering to tree care safety standards
  • Experienced with chainsaws, aerial lifts (bucket trucks), and other essential tree care equipment

Technical Knowledge:

  • Expertise in proper pruning cuts, branch collars, and chainsaw operations (for trees up to 50 feet)
  • Familiarity with ANSI A300 Pruning Standards and ANSI Z safety guidelines
  • Ability to perform aerial rescues and apply various climbing techniques
  • Comfortable working with a diverse range of tree species, including Oaks, Maples, Hemlocks, Pines, and more

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to lift and move up to 50 pounds frequently
  • Ability to safely perform climbing and aerial work in varying conditions
  • Experience with tree removal, including knowing when to use ropes or spikes for safe takedown

· This job requires physical stamina to meet the demands of climbing, lifting, and performing tasks outdoors. You’ll frequently lift and move heavy equipment and must be comfortable working in a variety of weather conditions.

Equal OpportunityAt SavATree, we believe in fostering a supportive environment where you can grow and succeed. We offer you the opportunity to advance your career and become an industry expert while working with a team that values both individual and collective success.

SavATree is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.

About SavATree

SavATree was founded 45 years ago with a mission to preserve trees and protect the natural landscapes we all enjoy. Since then, we've grown into a nationwide leader in tree, shrub, and lawn care services.

We're a values-driven organization built on teamwork, integrity, respect, and a shared commitment to the environment. We pride ourselves on offering a collaborative and supportive work culture where your expertise is valued, and your career path is clear. As we like to say: When you work here, you thrive here.

About the Role

As a Tree Climber with SavATree, you’ll be a key member of our General Tree Care Team. This team works on a variety of tree care tasks, including pruning, removals, and cabling. You’ll apply your expertise in climbing, pruning, and safety to ensure the health and beauty of our clients’ landscapes. The Crew Lead position offers additional responsibilities for those who demonstrate leadership qualities and want to guide a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Perform high-quality tree care services, including pruning, removals, and cabling for trees and shrubs
  • Climb trees safely using proper techniques, ropes, saddle, and ladders
  • Operate chainsaws, aerial lifts (bucket trucks), and other tree care equipment effectively
  • Apply ANSI A300 Pruning Standards and ANSI Z safety practices in all tasks
  • Ensure proper pruning cuts and techniques, preserving the health and structure of trees
  • Assist in tree removals and utilize ropes, spikes, and other equipment as needed for safe takedowns
  • Identify hazards and perform safety checks before, during, and after each job
  • Perform aerial rescues if necessary, ensuring safety in high-risk situations
  • Maintain strong communication with team members and clients, ensuring excellent service and safety at all times
  • Take ownership of your role, contributing to a positive, safety-focused team culture

What We’re Looking For

What is Essential:

  • Valid U.S. driver’s license (CDL is a plus)
  • Authorization to work legally in the U.S.
  • Passion for working outdoors and commitment to environmental stewardship

Experience:

  • Proficient in proper pruning techniques for large shade trees and ornamentals
  • Strong knowledge of tree and shrub species, including their characteristics
  • Comfortable climbing without spurs
  • Skilled in adhering to tree care safety standards
  • Experienced with chainsaws, aerial lifts (bucket trucks), and other essential tree care equipment

Technical Knowledge:

  • Expertise in proper pruning cuts, branch collars, and chainsaw operations (for trees up to 50 feet)
  • Familiarity with ANSI A300 Pruning Standards and ANSI Z safety guidelines
  • Ability to perform aerial rescues and apply various climbing techniques
  • Comfortable working with a diverse range of tree species, including Oaks, Maples, Hemlocks, Pines, and more

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to lift and move up to 50 pounds frequently
  • Ability to safely perform climbing and aerial work in varying conditions
  • Experience with tree removal, including knowing when to use ropes or spikes for safe takedown

· This job requires physical stamina to meet the demands of climbing, lifting, and performing tasks outdoors. You’ll frequently lift and move heavy equipment and must be comfortable working in a variety of weather conditions.

Equal OpportunityAt SavATree, we believe in fostering a supportive environment where you can grow and succeed. We offer you the opportunity to advance your career and become an industry expert while working with a team that values both individual and collective success.

SavATree is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.

title: Tree Climber -  Crew Leader
description:
Crew Lead Tree Climber

What We Offer

At SavATree, your success is our priority. Here’s how we invest in you:

  • Compensation: Competitive pay based on experience, skill level, and responsibilities.
  • Benefits: Health and dental insurance, paid time off, 401(k) Savings Plan, Flexible Spending Plan, and an Equipment Account.
  • Time Off: Time-off to support your work/life balance
  • Training & Development: Extensive training opportunities, including leadership development and continuing education support in the industry.
  • Tools for Success: Access to industry-leading equipment, climbing gear, and safety-focused crews.
  • Team Environment: Our Tree Care Team works alongside some of the best trained and equipped teams in the industry, with an emphasis on quality and safety.

About SavATree

SavATree was founded 45 years ago with a mission to preserve trees and protect the natural landscapes we all enjoy. Since then, we've grown into a nationwide leader in tree, shrub, and lawn care services.

We're a values-driven organization built on teamwork, integrity, respect, and a shared commitment to the environment. We pride ourselves on offering a collaborative and supportive work culture where your expertise is valued, and your career path is clear. As we like to say: When you work here, you thrive here.

About the Role

As a Tree Climber with SavATree, you’ll be a key member of our General Tree Care Team. This team works on a variety of tree care tasks, including pruning, removals, and cabling. You’ll apply your expertise in climbing, pruning, and safety to ensure the health and beauty of our clients’ landscapes. The Crew Lead position offers additional responsibilities for those who demonstrate leadership qualities and want to guide a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Perform high-quality tree care services, including pruning, removals, and cabling for trees and shrubs
  • Climb trees safely using proper techniques, ropes, saddle, and ladders
  • Operate chainsaws, aerial lifts (bucket trucks), and other tree care equipment effectively
  • Apply ANSI A300 Pruning Standards and ANSI Z safety practices in all tasks
  • Ensure proper pruning cuts and techniques, preserving the health and structure of trees
  • Assist in tree removals and utilize ropes, spikes, and other equipment as needed for safe takedowns
  • Identify hazards and perform safety checks before, during, and after each job
  • Perform aerial rescues if necessary, ensuring safety in high-risk situations
  • Maintain strong communication with team members and clients, ensuring excellent service and safety at all times
  • Take ownership of your role, contributing to a positive, safety-focused team culture

What We’re Looking For

What is Essential:

  • Valid U.S. driver’s license (CDL is a plus)
  • Authorization to work legally in the U.S.
  • Passion for working outdoors and commitment to environmental stewardship

Experience:

  • Proficient in proper pruning techniques for large shade trees and ornamentals
  • Strong knowledge of tree and shrub species, including their characteristics
  • Comfortable climbing without spurs
  • Skilled in adhering to tree care safety standards
  • Experienced with chainsaws, aerial lifts (bucket trucks), and other essential tree care equipment

Technical Knowledge:

  • Expertise in proper pruning cuts, branch collars, and chainsaw operations (for trees up to 50 feet)
  • Familiarity with ANSI A300 Pruning Standards and ANSI Z safety guidelines
  • Ability to perform aerial rescues and apply various climbing techniques
  • Comfortable working with a diverse range of tree species, including Oaks, Maples, Hemlocks, Pines, and more

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to lift and move up to 50 pounds frequently
  • Ability to safely perform climbing and aerial work in varying conditions
  • Experience with tree removal, including knowing when to use ropes or spikes for safe takedown

· This job requires physical stamina to meet the demands of climbing, lifting, and performing tasks outdoors. You’ll frequently lift and move heavy equipment and must be comfortable working in a variety of weather conditions.

Equal OpportunityAt SavATree, we believe in fostering a supportive environment where you can grow and succeed. We offer you the opportunity to advance your career and become an industry expert while working with a team that values both individual and collective success.

SavATree is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.

title: Natural Resources Consulting Technician
description:
Purpose of the Role:

The Natural Resources Consulting Technician position collects data on tree location, species, size, condition, and information as needed. The work is performed using GIS and GPS on mobile devices in the field for analysis and reporting by the Consulting Arborist. Assignments may include but are not limited to tree inventory, tree management planning, tree preservation, and tree appraisal. Work may be accomplished independently or as part of a team and responsibilities include client communication.

Essential Functions of the Role:

  • Collect field location and attribute data on trees within the scope of work using mobile GIS and GPS software and hardware.
  • Provide completed maps and tables for analysis and reporting by Consulting Arborist.
  • Converse with clients in a professional manner to provide additional information, answer questions and ensure targeted solutions are successful.
  • Communicate frequently with field crews and contribute to positive teamwork environment.
  • Complete reports on computer tablets and provide feedback to the responsible Arborist detailing: problems cited, actions taken, and results achieved.
  • Participate in meetings and debriefs with Managers and other specialists related to productivity, safety (including regulatory compliance), and quality.
  • Work efficiently and productively on a daily basis meeting established key performance indicators (KPIs). Demonstrate flexibility regarding work hours and days based on weather events.
  • Maintain compliance with all Federal, State, and local laws and regulations as well as company policies.
  • Work in a consistent state of alertness and safe manner.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement culture as defined by Lean Sigma policies and procedures.
  • Advance towards attainment of ISA Certified Arborist and Tree Risk Assessment Qualification in order to become a Consulting Arborist.
  • May assist Consulting Arborist(s) with basic report writing tasks.

Decision Making Authority:

· Autonomy based on experience, as needed coordinate with Consulting Arborist.

Working Relationships:

Internal: Consulting Arborist, Branch Manager, Operations Manager, Office Manager, Field Specialists, and Sales Arborists

External: Clients, Vendors

Qualifications for this Role:

  • Associate or Bachelor’s degree from an accredited College or University in Arboriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Biology, Plant Science, Environmental Sciences, or a relevant experience.

· Possess a valid driver’s license to operate motor vehicle in governing state.

· Minimum of 21 years of age

· Minimum 2 years of experience in field data collection and analysis.

· Ability to prioritize and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.

· Efficiency in working independently or with a team.

· Proficient with computer programs including Microsoft Office suite and various tree inventory software platforms.

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills with customer service focus.

· Problem solving skills to apply knowledge to specific situations and identify appropriate solutions.

Physical Environment:

Field, which may include both developed and undeveloped lands, and traditional office environment.

Physical Demands:

Stand, walk, and work outdoors outside for full days in during projects, sometimes in adverse weather conditions.

Activities include balance, bending, climbing, and kneeling.

Ability to lift 50 pounds.

Must be able to sit and navigate/use computer system and/or use a tablet.

May be requested to work overtime and weekends.

Travel within Branch, District, and Region territories based on project needs.

title: Crew Lead - Tree Climber
description:
This position currently has a sign-on bonus of $2,000 and pays $25-35/hr depending on your experience + paid PTO + paid benefits and 401K!

Looking for a place where you can thrive?

SavATree’s mission is to take our passion for nature and keep this country’s outdoors beautiful and flourishing. Through our comprehensive tree, shrub, and lawn care we work hard to make sure our discerning customers have attractive, healthy and cared-for green spaces to enjoy. Over the last thirty years, we have opened new offices across the country, and we are looking for people who want to grow with us.

The General Tree Care Team are the muscle of our operation. These industrial athletes work together to provide high-quality tree care, helping to maintain and preserve the overall health of our clients’ landscapes.

In this role, team members have the opportunity to work outside and visit beautiful properties in their community. The Tree Care team applies expertise in climbing, pruning, and safety to ensure the health and well-being of each client’s landscape.

The Crew Lead position is an additional level of specialty for select individuals who have demonstrated leadership qualities and received approval from the local branch management to provide direction in a work crew setting. Specific knowledge includes: TCIA Crew Leader Training Program, Crew Safety, Personal Safety, Hazard of Inexperience, and ability to check off levels equal and below.

What a day is like:

Daily focus is working together on a General Tree Care crew to provide high quality tree care to our clients. The Tree Care Team is involved in all aspects of pruning, removals, cable bracing and other concepts related to tree care. Team members are able to safely operate all equipment and perform the assigned job tasks while also providing excellent service to our clients.

What kind of person are we looking for? Someone with:

  • Experience with proper pruning practices including large shade trees and ornamentals
  • Ability to identify native and introduced tree and shrub species and have a working knowledge of each species’ characteristics
  • Ability to climb without spurs
  • Experience with tree care safety standards
  • Practical knowledge of chainsaw and equipment operation
  • Experience with aerial lifts (bucket truck)
  • Demonstrate additional competencies in all areas of knowledge for designated skill level.
  • Communicate advanced understanding of all safety policies and procedures, including hazard tree identification.
  • Utilize specialized equipment properly for climbing (ropes, saddle, ladders) along with all associated tools.
  • Apply knowledge of branch collars and proper pruning cuts with total competence on chainsaw operations in small to medium difficulty (40-50’) trees.
  • Employ ANSI A300 Pruning Standards and Terminology and ANSI Z safety.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of different tree species and different techniques necessary for climbing each tree including Oaks, Maples, Dogwoods, Apples (Crab vs. Regular), Hemlocks, Pines and Spruce.
  • Complete work exhibiting ability to raise a ladder, throw a rope, and safe techniques to climb into a tree.
  • Set up safely with proper placement of lowering lines in a strong enough crotch, know when to attach a tag line, and engage proper lowering techniques.
  • Know when to double crotch and use other appropriate techniques when working in trees.
  • Able to drop trees, know when to use ropes for take down and identify potential need to use spikes.
  • Perform aerial rescue if needed.

What is Essential:

  • The desire to work outdoors
  • Valid U.S. driver's license to operate company vehicles, CDL a plus
  • Must be authorized to work lawfully in the U.S.

  • Physical demands of this role:

    These physical demands described must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of the job, the employee is subject to frequently lift and/or move up to fifty (50) pounds.

Why you might love working here:

  • We have lots of training and development opportunities and support continuing education in the industry
  • Our Tree Care Team works alongside some of the best trained and equipped teams in the industry, with an emphasis on quality and safety
  • We offer competitive compensation and benefits, including health and dental, paid time off, 401(K) Savings Plan, Flexible Spending Plan, Equipment Account

We want everyone to be able to identify and achieve their own version of success, which means giving each team member the room and opportunity to grow. To ensure that everyone has the best chance to succeed, we invest heavily in training and continuing education. We make it easy for team members to reach out and get the help needed, even when it’s from the other side of the country. We pride ourselves on creating an environment where each team member has the resources and opportunities to advance his or her career and become a go-to subject matter expert. That’s why we often say that when you work here, you thrive here.

SavATree is an equal opportunity employer and a Drug Free Workplace

Lawn Care Specialists work independently, allowing team members to choose the proper product or customized blend application to be utilized in treating various lawn problems. This role also provides the opportunity to communicate with clients by providing them with comprehensive information about their lawns. Why you might love working here:

title: SAP EWM Senior Consultant
description:
Job Description

Role summary:

SAP EWM Senior Consultant

Digitalization is a strategic priority for ROCKWOOL. The SAP EWM Senior Consultant ensures stability, performance, and alignment of SAP Variant Configuration and Controlling processes with Group standards during both support and project activities.

Reporting Structure

Team Members:

· The SAP EWM Senior Consultant operationally to the SAP Support sub team – Team Lead, who coordinates day-to-day activities, ensures alignment with SAP teams goals, and facilitates team cohesion.

Key responsibilities and activities include, but is not limited to:

Solution Design & Implementation

•Collaborate with business stakeholders and the Business Process Owner (BPO) to gather and document requirements and identify deviations from the standard template.

Translating business needs into a robust SAP EWM solution, ensuring alignment with the global template and EWM best practices.

•Design and configure the SAP EWM / MFS system to support automated warehouse and AGV integration while enabling efficient and scalable warehouse processes.

Configuration & Integration

•Lead the configuration of SAP EWM and MFS settings.

•Integrate SAP EWM with related SAP modules (PP, MM, LES) and connected services including FIORI apps, terminals, printers, RFID scanners, tablets, and telegram-based communication with WCS and AGVs.

•Support FIORI and ABAP development activities in collaboration with development teams in relation to EWM and MFS interfaces.


Interface & automation

•Design interface architecture and define telegram structures between SAP EWM and

  • Warehouse Control Systems (WCS)
  • AGV fleet management software
  • Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs)

Ensure telegram development and testing are compliant with the global template and support seamless system-to-system communication.

•Work closely with AGV and automation suppliers to validate interface specifications and coordinate integration testing.

Testing & Validation

•SOLMAN tool is the Test tool selected

•Drive end-to-end testing cycles, including unit, integration, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) / smoke tests, ensuring that the complete solution — including interfaces with automation hardware — meets business and technical requirements.

•Participate in process-level discussions to ensure testing scope and scenarios reflect agreed template processes.

Project & Stakeholder Collaboration

•Act as the functional and technical link between warehouse super users, the EWM project team, and integration teams.

•Support integration testing, go-live preparation and go live in complex environments.

•Provide expert guidance on EWM and MFS to ensure quality and consistency across project streams.

Training, Support & Transition

•Deliver targeted training sessions for super users to ensure operational readiness.

•Support post-go-live activities, including issue resolution, stabilization, and hypercare.

•Lead the service transition from project delivery to the EWM support team to ensure continuity.

Continuous Improvement

•Monitor system performance and recommend optimizations to improve warehouse efficiency and system responsiveness.

•Identify and implement improvements aligned with evolving business needs and automation capabilities.

Documentation & Governance

•Ensure comprehensive documentation of all configuration settings, custom developments, interface designs, and process changes.

•Adhere to governance models and change management processes, ensuring compliance with project standards.

Team & Culture

•Foster a collaborative, customer-focused, and cross-functional team culture.

•Promote flexibility, accountability, and alignment across streams and departments.

Core Functional Scope

  • SAP expertise in EWM / MFS
  • Inbound / internal and outbound warehouse flows including strategies to connect EWM and MFS.
  • Warehouse Master Data (EWM)
  • Industry experience in warehouse execution will be added advantage.

  • Time Management/ Planning (commitment)

  • Strong background in automated warehouse design and integration with SAP.

title: HSE Specialist
description:
Royal IHC is op zoek naar een Senior HSE Specialist voor de afdeling Health, Safety & Environment.


In deze rol ondersteun je de business bij het waarborgen van een veilige en gezonde werkomgeving, zowel op Royal IHC-terrein als op projectlocaties. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen, implementeren en bewaken van HSE-beleid en -richtlijnen, zodat werkzaamheden veilig, duurzaam en volgens geldende wet- en regelgeving kunnen worden uitgevoerd.


Als HSE Specialist rapporteer je direct aan de Manager Health, Safety & Environment en ben je vooral aan het werk voor de werf in Kinderdijk. Je bent niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor het borgen van beleid, maar ook voor het verder brengen van Royal IHC: je initieert verbeteringen, stimuleert een proactieve veiligheidscultuur en vertaalt HSE-beleid naar praktische en werkbare oplossingen.
Daarnaast heb je een coördinerende rol in het I-CARE veiligheidsprogramma en draag je bij aan de verdere professionalisering van HSE binnen Royal IHC.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

• Beheren van het managementsysteem volgens ISO-45001 en ISO-14001 certificaten;
• Coördineren en verder ontwikkelen van het I-CARE veiligheidsprogramma;
• Fungeren als senior sparringspartner voor het management en de werf;
• Realiseren van de doelstellingen uit het HSE-plan;
• Onderzoek verrichten naar aanleiding van ongevallen en onveilige situaties;
• Ondersteunen van de organisatie op de naleving van de HSE-procedure,- en instructies;
• Het opstellen van de nodige analyses, rapportages en implementatie van preventieve maatregelen.


Wat breng jij mee:
• Je beschikt over een afgeronde opleiding in veiligheidskunde (IVK of HVK), kandidaten met een MVK-diploma en passende aanvullende ervaring nodigen we nadrukkelijk uit om te reageren;

• Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen Safety, Health & Environment;

• Sterke affiniteit met techniek, ervaring met of interesse in maritieme techniek is een pre;
• Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal (vereist);
• Ervaring met verandering en verbeterprogramma’s;
• Bekend met relevante wet- en regelgeving;
• Bekend met certificaten als ISO-45001 en ISO-14001;
• Je bent praktisch-pragmatisch, praktisch maken van voorschriften om ze toepasbaar te maken.


Let op: Een VOG (Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag) en het kunnen verkrijgen én behouden van de vereiste veiligheidsmachtiging zijn verplicht voor deze functie.

Een relevante screening maakt onderdeel uit van het selectieproces.

Royal IHC biedt jou:
• Een salaris tussen €5500 en €7000 bruto per maand (op basis van jouw ervaring en senioriteit), plus 8% vakantiegeld;
• Veel vrije tijd: 40 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de optie om extra verlof te kopen of te verkopen;
• Een winstdelingsregeling waarmee je meedeelt in het succes van Royal IHC;
• Flexibel werken: Een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,45 p/dag + eenmalig € 750 om je werkplek in te richten;
• Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,21 per kilometer voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor reist;
• Een solide pensioenopbouw via PME;
• Ruimte om te groeien: veel interne doorgroeimogelijkheden en een opleidingsbudget + toegang tot onze IHC Academy om jouw ontwikkeling te stimuleren;

•Vitaliteit en energie: onbeperkt sporten in onze eigen fitnessruimte (in ruil voor de duurzame inzetbaarheidsdag);
• Royal IHC zorgt voor zaken waar jij als sollicitant liever niet mee bezig bent, maar die wél belangrijk zijn. Met een arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering, partnerpensioen en de mogelijkheid om via ons Sociaal Fonds extra zorgkosten deels vergoed te krijgen.

title: Account Manager
description:
Clarivate is a global leader committed to innovation and collaboration, offering an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally.   • Minimum 5 years of professional experience, including at least 2 years in B2B sales
  • Familiarity with Intellectual Property industry or legal industry workflows.
  • Experience in consultative, solution-based selling
  • Experienced with value-based selling methodologies (MEDDPICC)
  • Strong presentation skills and a team player to collaborate with stakeholders across the business.
  • Ability to support customer training and knowledge sharing to improve customer experience.

It would be great if you also have . . .

  • Experience in selling outsourced solutions
  • Experience working with data, analytics, intellectual property solutions or legal industry workflows.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Experience working in complex, multi-stakeholder sales environments

What will you be doing in this role?

This role is measured by your ability to grow, retain, and expand your accounts.

  • Achieve sales goals by meeting targets and proactively identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling
  • Own and drive revenue growth across your portfolio, with a strong focus on expanding existing customer relationships
  • Ensure customers are maximizing the value of their current solutions, identifying gaps, and positioning additional services where relevant

Our team is based in the Australia, New Zealand and South-East region, however, is part of a global team where you will have the opportunity to work with and engage with global teams.

The role will be reporting to the Senior Director based in Australia and work closely with a team across Australia, New Zealand and South-East Asia region.

Hours of Work

This is a full-time position, primarily working core business hours in your time zone, with flexibility to adjust to various global time zones as needed.

Location preference is Pennag, however other locations will be considered.

At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

title: Saints Foundation Communications & Marketing Manager

Hours: Full Time

Contract Type: Permanent

Salary: Up to £37,000

What is the role?

We are looking for a dynamic Marketing & Communications Manager to elevate our digital presence, champion powerful storytelling, and strengthen the connection between our work and the people we support, with our donors, fans and community.

What will you be doing?

You will strategically develop innovative ways to share the charity’s impact and manage all content and marketing outputs to deliver against Saints Foundation’s Marketing & Communications strategy and business KPI’s while working with the Head of Marketing & Fundraising to drive innovation and engagement across all communications to position the charity as a leader in its field.

Leading integrated marketing and fundraising campaigns from concept to delivery, you will be accountable for the development of all content while overseeing digital channels and optimising opportunities to use the brand of Southampton FC to support the charity's objectives. You will lead on all press and PR connections, ensuring the charity builds its public profiles and manage all incoming media enquiries while building strong relationships with local media, partners and stakeholders to amplify the Saints Foundation reach. It will be your responsibility to draft press releases, statements, and key messages for internal and external audiences, as well as support crisis communications and reputation management when required.

Managing relationships with key suppliers, you will ensure they understand our work and we deliver the best value for the charity's investment. You will monitor finances (Including income and expenditure) to ensure all campaigns and content are delivered within the prescribed budget, and records of all spend is collated in accordance with policy.

You will train, guide and mentor your team to help them succeed in their roles with regular meetings, which ensure objectives are in place and an up-to-date and Personal Development Plans are regularly reviewed. You will manage performance for all team members, whether poor or good, in a constructive manner and address issues quickly to eliminate possible disruption to the team dynamic while also ensuring recognition and reward for high performance.

Engaging with project staff and our participants to identify powerful stories, you will ensure participant stories are captured and shared as part of a planned communications calendar which showcases our work, increases advocacy and engages the community.

Is this you?

You will need to be a strategic and creative operator, with the ability to communicate and work with people at all levels of the organisation and to understand the needs of our participants, how our projects operate and effectively communicate the impact that the charity has.

  • Worldwide Travel Insurance for you and your family.

  • Learning & Development opportunities - supporting you to develop your potential and achieve in your career.

  • Free onsite parking.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme.

  • Collaborative & inclusive working culture.

How can I apply?

Just click on the apply button, enter your details and answer a quick pre-screening questionnaire, then attach your CV.

The closing date for this role is 7 July 2026.

*We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, if a high volume of applicants are received. *

We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and adults at risk and we expect everyone to share this commitment. You will be required to adhere to all relevant policies and uphold the Club’s commitment to safeguarding children, young people and adults at risk and to ensure that Southampton Football Club is free from discrimination and harassment.

The post holder will demonstrate a strong commitment to equality, diversity, and inclusion, supporting the organisation’s strategic aims to remove barriers and address inequality. You will play an active role in promoting an inclusive, discrimination-free environment that ensures fair access to opportunities and resources. This includes fostering a culture of dignity, respect, and belonging where everyone is empowered to contribute, perform, and reach their full potential.

The new Bio Injectable products manufacturing unit in Brnik will deliver advanced pharmaceutical products to patients worldwide, with a strong focus on biosimilars that require the highest standards of quality, professionalism, and dedication. If you are driven by purpose and want to co-create a success story with global impact through your expertise and commitment, we invite you to join us.

As Site Quality Head (d/ž/m), you will provide leadership and drive people development within the quality organization. You will be responsible for the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of quality assurance processes and quality control systems supporting release activities. In this role, you will ensure the delivery of high-quality, customer-focused services in compliance with applicable legislation, internal regulations, recognized good practices, and business objectives.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Quality Organization Leadership at Site Level: Leading, developing, and steering the quality function at the site, ensuring the professional and personal development of team members, as well as high levels of engagement and team performance.
  • Product Quality Assurance and Oversight of Regulated Activities: End-to-end oversight of all activities impacting product quality, safety, and compliance across manufacturing, control, and distribution processes.
  • Regulatory Compliance and Interaction with Health Authorities: Ensuring compliance with applicable legislation and internal requirements, maintaining product and site registrations, and preparing and maintaining core site documentation for regulatory purposes.
  • Quality System Management and Risk Management: Conducting quality risk assessments, performing regular reviews of the Quality Management System, and ensuring effective handling of deviations, non-conformances, and complaints.
  • Inspection Readiness, Audits, and Third-Party Management: Maintaining continuous readiness for regulatory and internal inspections and ensuring that collaboration with third parties is governed by appropriate quality agreements.
  • Training and Competency of Employees: Ensuring employees are adequately trained and qualified to perform their tasks independently, with regular monitoring of training compliance and professional competencies.
  • Safety, Health, Environment, and Business Continuity: Promoting a culture of safety and quality, ensuring compliance with health, safety, and environmental requirements, supporting crisis management activities, and ensuring business continuity.

What you will bring to the role:

  • University degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, or another relevant scientific discipline.
  • A minimum of 5 years of work experience in the field of quality, development, or manufacturing.
  • Active proficiency in English.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools.

What we offer:

  • Job location: Ljubljana and Brnik, Slovenia
  • Contract type: permanent contract with 6-month probation period
  • Expected weekly working hours: 40 hours per week
  • *Pay range: 117.600 – 176.400 EUR gross

*Salary at Sandoz is based on job level, qualifications, specific skills, and work experience. Fully proficient candidates are usually placed around the market median, less experienced candidates lower in the range, and those with strong or niche expertise higher. When determining placement within the range, we also consider internal pay equity and external market data.

Our compensation package additionally includes:

  • Annual bonus (STI): percentage of annual gross salary
  • Long Term bonus (LTI): percentage of annual gross salary
  • Vacation allowance: in 2025 it was €2,430.99 net

  • Collective life and accident insurance (24/7 coverage)
  • A hybrid work environment offering flexibility and remote work possibilities – if applicable for position

Ready for your next career move?

Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have the ambition to do more so that everyone can benefit from the basic human right of good health.

With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape a sustainable future for Sandoz and to help even more people gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines.

Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!

Join us in helping to make healthcare fairer and faster.

title: Principal Sales Engineer
description:

Emerging Technologies

title: Commodity Buyer
description:
Commodity Manager – Direct Spend

Bouw mee aan een toekomstbestendige supply base

Als Commodity Manager – Direct Spend bij BDR Thermea Group speel je een sleutelrol in het ontwikkelen van leveranciersstrategieën die bijdragen aan kwaliteit, leveringsbetrouwbaarheid, kostenbeheersing, duurzaamheid en continuïteit.

Je opereert in een internationale omgeving en werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit onder andere R&D, Quality, Supply Chain, Sustainability en procurement. In deze rol breng je strategie en uitvoering samen — en maak je direct impact op de business.

Wat ga je doen?

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor een toegewezen commodity en zorgt ervoor dat de juiste leveranciersstrategie wordt ontwikkeld en uitgevoerd. Daarbij houd je je onder meer bezig met:

  • ontwikkelen en implementeren van commodity- en leveranciersstrategieën

  • optimaliseren van het leveranciersportfolio en bouwen aan preferred supplier-relaties

  • verbeteren van leveranciersprestaties op het gebied van kwaliteit, levering, duurzaamheid en innovatie

  • realiseren van kostenreducties en sturen op waardecreatie, onder andere via TCO en value engineering

  • betrekken van leveranciers bij New Product Development en innovatieprojecten

  • signaleren en beheersen van risico’s binnen de supply base

  • initiëren van procesverbeteringen en bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van procurement

Je werkt in een internationale matrixorganisatie en speelt een belangrijke rol in het verbinden van belangen, creëren van draagvlak en aanjagen van verbetering.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die strategisch sterk is, maar ook praktisch en verbindend werkt.

Je brengt in elk geval mee:

  • hbo werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in Procurement, Supply Chain, Bedrijfskunde, Engineering of vergelijkbaar

  • minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen Procurement, Supplier Management, Supply Chain of Commodity Management

  • sterke vaardigheden in stakeholdermanagement en onderhandelen

  • analytisch vermogen en een scherp oog voor verbetering

  • goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels

  • kennis van SAP is een pré

Dit bieden wij:

  • Een vast contract met een startsalaris van €4900 - €6500 per maand op basis van fulltime dienstverband en afhankelijk van ervaring.

  • Dertiende maand.

  • Een sterke pensioenregeling.

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv-dagen per kalenderjaar op basis van een fulltime dienstverband.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Een uitdagende rol in een team dat voor elkaar klaar staat en elkaar helpt en ondersteunt.

De context

Je maakt onderdeel uit van een wereldwijd procurement netwerk binnen BDR Thermea Group, met zo’n 90 tot 100 professionals. Je vertaalt de globale procurementstrategie naar concrete acties binnen de lokale organisatie en werkt daarbij samen met stakeholders in verschillende landen, functies en business units.

Waarom deze rol?

Deze functie biedt je de kans om te werken in een internationale context waar je zichtbaar bijdraagt aan strategische keuzes, leveranciersontwikkeling en verdere professionalisering van procurement. Een rol met inhoud, invloed en veel ruimte om samen met anderen resultaat te boeken.

Interesse?

Spreekt dit je aan en wil je impact maken binnen een internationale procurementomgeving? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Solliciteer via de button.

Wil je meer weten over de functie? Neem dan contact op met Rianne Koers, onze recruiter, via rianne.koers@remeha.nl

At BDR Thermea Group, we believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I) are critical to our success. We are committed to creating a workplace where every potential future employee feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. Please check out our DE&I policy on our website to find out more.

description:

title: Software R&D Engineer
description:
Job Description

Join Agilent’s ICP-MS Software R&D team and help create software for advanced analytical instruments that support important work in laboratories around the world. Our technology is used in chemical analysis, environmental testing, and life science applications, and this role offers the opportunity to apply your software engineering skills to products that have clear real-world impact.

This is a strong opportunity for engineers who enjoy thoughtful product development, stable long-term engineering work, and solving technical problems in collaboration with others. You may already have experience in instrument control or Windows desktop development, or you may come from adjacent areas such as embedded systems, industrial software, device communication, automation, or other software environments where reliability, maintainability, and quality are important.

What You’ll Work On

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain software used to operate and control ICP-MS instruments.
  • Build robust, reliable, and maintainable software features that support instrument performance, usability, and quality.
  • Investigate technical challenges, analyze issues, and contribute to effective long-term solutions.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, scientists, and cross-functional partners to turn requirements into practical product solutions.
  • Contribute to design discussions, technical documentation, integration, and product release activities.
  • Continuously learn new technologies, tools, and domain knowledge relevant to analytical instrument software.

Qualifications

Who We’re Open to Considering

We are open to candidates from a broad range of software engineering backgrounds. If you have built software in environments that require careful design, debugging, long-term maintenance, or close collaboration with other technical teams, your experience may be highly relevant here. Direct experience in scientific instruments is welcome, but not essential.

We are especially interested in engineers with strong object-oriented programming foundations and a genuine interest in building reliable products over time. Candidates from C#/.NET, Windows applications, embedded software, industrial systems, data processing, backend systems, or other complex software environments are all encouraged to apply.

For engineers in Japan who value craftsmanship, technical ownership, and meaningful global collaboration, this role offers the opportunity to help shape the future of ICP-MS software from Japan, a key development hub, while partnering with colleagues across functions and sites worldwide.

If you do not meet every preferred qualification exactly, we still encourage you to apply. We value strong software fundamentals, learning agility, professionalism, and the motivation to contribute to high-quality product development in a collaborative environment.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in software development using object-oriented programming concepts.
  • Ability to understand, modify, and improve existing code in a structured and maintainable way.
  • Experience or interest in technical investigation, debugging, and problem solving.
  • Interest in working on software connected to physical systems, instruments, devices, or data-rich applications.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and build domain knowledge in analytical instruments.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with local and global team members.
  • Japanese language ability for day-to-day work, and sufficient written English for technical collaboration.

Preferred Experience

  • C#/.NET or Windows application development.
  • Software for instrument control, device communication, measurement, automation, or industrial systems.
  • Scientific, analytical, regulated, or data-intensive software environments.
  • Experience working across the software lifecycle, from requirements through release and support.
  • Exposure to chemistry, analytical instruments, or adjacent technical domains.

Why Join Us

At Agilent, you can build a long-term career while working on products that matter. This role offers the opportunity to deepen your software engineering expertise, learn a specialized technical domain, and contribute to high-quality products in a collaborative R&D environment that values reliability, continuous improvement, and teamwork.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule.

Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations

title: Finance Director
description:

Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, USA, we serve customers across industrial, transportation, and electronics markets worldwide. With approximately 16,000 employees we design and manufacture innovative technologies that support electrification, energy efficiency, and advanced automation. Our global reach is matched by a culture that empowers innovation and long-term growth. Guided by our principles We Care, We Succeed With Our Customers, and We Own the Outcome, we work collaboratively, think boldly, and deliver solutions that move industries forward.

Littelfuse is seeking a strategic and results-driven Finance Director to lead the finance function for a Semiconductor Business Unit. Reporting directly to the VP Finance, Semiconductor BU, and with a strong dotted line to the Business Unit General Manager, this role is a key member of the leadership team. You will play a pivotal role in shaping business strategy, driving financial performance, and leading a global finance organization. This is an opportunity to partner closely with business leaders to enhance profitability, enable growth, and strengthen financial processes and systems globally.

About the job:

Strategic Finance Leadership

  • Act as a key member of the Business Unit leadership team

  • Develop short- and long-term financial strategies, ensuring alignment with business objectives

  • Provide financial insights to drive decisions across:

    • Product, customer, and channel profitability

    • Manufacturing and supply chain cost optimization

    • R&D efficiency and investment prioritization

    • Working capital and return on capital

    • Market and competitive dynamics

  • Lead the evolution of the finance function, including:

    • Organizational structure and operating model

    • Standardized global reporting and controls

    • ERP evaluation and transformation strategy

    • Process harmonization and cost efficiencies

  • Support M&A activities, including due diligence, ROI analysis, and integration

Financial Planning, Analysis & Insights

  • Deliver best-in-class financial analysis and business performance insights

  • Lead monthly and quarterly global reporting, including:

    • Income statement, balance sheet, capital expenditure, and working capital

  • Analyze results vs. targets, identifying key drivers and actionable recommendations

  • Develop executive dashboards, KPIs, and financial benchmarking reports

  • Provide forward-looking insights to support decision-making and investment priorities

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and develop a high-performing global finance organization across:

    • FP&A

    • Commercial finance

    • Controllership

    • Financial systems and integration

  • Set clear objectives aligned to business strategy and ensure accountability

  • Coach, develop, and retain top talent

Governance & Business Stewardship

  • Ensure strong financial controls, compliance, and reporting integrity

  • Partner with Corporate Finance to strengthen global financial governance

  • Promote a culture of transparency, ethics, and accountability

  • Challenge assumptions and ensure alignment of investments with strategy

About you:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field

  • CPA and/or MBA preferred

  • Proven finance leadership experience in a multinational, publicly traded company

  • Strong background in manufacturing and operations finance

title: Senior Research Scientist – New Zealand
description:
Join Corteva Agriscience and help shape the future of crop protection in New Zealand.

At Corteva, we’re driven by a clear purpose: to enrich the lives of those who produce and those who consume, ensuring progress for generations to come. We’re looking for a highly capable Field Scientist to lead field trial programs and play a key role in bringing innovative crop protection solutions to life.

About the Role

As a Field Scientist, you will be accountable for the design, execution, and delivery of field trial programs that evaluate the performance of new and existing crop protection products across New Zealand. Working closely with regional and global R&D teams, you’ll generate high-quality data, translate insights into actionable recommendations, and contribute directly to product development and registration strategies.

This is a highly collaborative role where you’ll work across cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Regulatory, and Customer Agronomy, while also engaging with external research partners and industry stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead end-to-end management of field trial programs, including protocol design, regulatory compliance, execution, and data analysis
  • Design and conduct internal small-plot trials, ensuring technical accuracy and high data integrity
  • Collaborate with Contract Research Organizations (CROs) and oversee externally managed trials
  • Analyse and interpret trial data, delivering clear insights and recommendations on product performance
  • Contribute to regional and global data summaries and support the development of registration dossiers
  • Provide technical expertise to support product positioning, market development, and launch readiness
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to define local biological needs, product concepts, and business cases
  • Support training and education initiatives for both internal teams and external customers
  • Monitor industry trends, resistance issues, and competitor activity to inform strategy
  • Represent Corteva within the NZ agricultural research and industry landscape

What You Bring

  • A degree in agricultural, biological or plant science (BSc, MSc or PhD preferred)
  • At least 5 years’ experience in crop protection, plant health, or related field research
  • Strong expertise in field trial design, statistical methods, and data analysis
  • Proven ability to translate technical data into clear insights and written reports (e.g., biological dossiers)
  • A practical, solutions-oriented mindset with strong project management capability
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to build relationships across industry
  • A strong commitment to safety, stewardship, and compliance

Travel Requirements

This role involves regular travel across New Zealand to manage trial sites, engage with research partners, and support field-based activities. Occasional travel may also be required to support commercial teams and attend key meetings or field events.

Why Join Corteva?

  • Be part of a global leader in agriculture innovation
  • Work on cutting-edge crop protection technologies
  • Collaborate with world-class scientists and industry experts
  • Contribute to sustainable agriculture outcomes in New Zealand
  • Enjoy a supportive, safety-first culture with strong development opportunities

title: Service Delivery Consultant
description:
Service Delivery Consultant

WHAT MAKES US, US

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

As financial markets continue to evolve, the accuracy and reliability of risk analytics become increasingly important for our clients. To support our continued global growth, we are looking for a Service Delivery Consultant with a keen interest in financial data and technology to join our Axioma Managed Services team in Warsaw.

In this role, you will be part of a global team responsible for ensuring that institutional investor clients receive accurate, timely risk analytics and data services they can depend on. You will work closely with Technology Solutions consultants, product managers, engineers, market data analysts, and clients in an international and highly collaborative environment.

This is a valuable opportunity to build expertise in financial data operations, risk analytics, and client service delivery — working with real-world data across equities, fixed income, and OTC derivatives, while gaining practical experience with modern, cloud-native financial technology. This role offers the opportunity to grow your knowledge of financial analytics at the heart of one of the world’s leading investment management platforms, contributing to solutions used by leading financial institutions worldwide

WHAT WILL YOU BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

The Service Delivery Consultant will be joining a highly productive entrepreneurial team, itself part of a global organization, supporting SimCorp’s AxiomaRisk clients within the Axioma Managed Services department. After a comprehensive training program, we expect you to:

  • Perform end-to-end analytics data delivery activities for assigned clients, including pricing and holdings data import, in line with agreed SLE/SLAs

  • Perform data quality checks and conduct initial analysis when unexpected analytics data behaviour is identified

  • Ensure reconciliations are finished and troubleshoot discrepancies within set deadlines, in accordance with client SLAs

  • Gain a working understanding of AxiomaRisk’s infrastructure, including delivery mechanisms through which clients submit portfolio positions (API, SFTP) and receive risk analytics

  • Work with complex financial datasets related to portfolio positions and OTC derivatives, including FX Forwards and Interest Rate Swaps

  • Maintain accurate documentation of business processes, operational procedures, and functional guidelines

  • Collaborate with global Managed Services teams to share knowledge and ensure consistency of service delivery

  • Support client-facing communication by assisting in the preparation of issue updates, data delivery confirmations, and responses to client inquiries in coordination with senior team members

  • Assist Product Specialists, Technology Solutions, and Client Support teams in resolving data inquiries

WHAT WE VALUE

  • 2–3 years of experience in financial services, data operations, or a related field within the investment management or financial technology industry

  • Some exposure to client-facing communication, whether through direct client interaction, support activities, or internal stakeholder engagement

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or Engineering from an accredited institution

  • Good understanding of financial instruments, including equities, fixed income, and derivatives

  • Solid methodological and quantitative problem-solving skills, with a detail-oriented mindset

  • Foundational knowledge of or exposure to SQL, API and Python (or equivalent scripting tools)

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional team across multiple time zones

  • Curiosity, a continuous improvement mindset, and a genuine interest in financial technology

ADDITIONAL VALUABLE SKILLS

  • Knowledge of risk analytics concepts, derivatives pricing, or factor-based risk modelling

  • CFA or FRM certification (in progress or planned)

  • Experience with data quality analysis and exception handling workflows

  • Prior experience with AxiomaRisk or SimCorp Dimension

BENEFITS

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid model - 2 days in the office, 3 days remote

  • Modern office (next to Wilanowska metro station) with quiet zones and ergonomic workstations

  • Base salary with annual bonus structure

  • Holiday allowance upon a 2-week vacation

  • Occasional remote work across Poland and international options available (up to 24 days domestic, 20 days international per year - subject to internal policy)

  • Employer-paid Medicover Platinum healthcare package (employee-paid family upgrade available)

  • MyBenefit Cafeteria with a monthly budget provided by SimCorp, which can be used to finance a Multisport card (with a 25% employee contribution) or choose other lifestyle options

  • Unum group life insurance (employee-paid upgrade available)

  • Medicover travel insurance for private trips and global business travel insurance

  • Possibility to join Deutsche Börse Group Share Plan (eligible after 1 year)

  • Copyrights program for certain roles

  • Possibility to develop your career in an international environment

  • Professional training and courses provided by SimCorp

  • Polish language classes for foreign employees; German and English classes based on business needs

  • Integration events, volunteering initiatives and employee-led clubs

Compensation ranges are being disclosed at the initial stage of candidate engagement.

Visit our career pages to learn more about working at SimCorp:

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: Myyjä, Prisma Piispanristi, Turun Osuuskauppa
description:
Primary location:

KAARINA

Prisma Piispanristi etsii myyjiä kassaosastolle, päivittäistavaraosastolle sekä käyttötavaraosastolle.

Työsuhteet ovat vakituisia 10-15 tuntia viikossa. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan elokuun alussa.

Haemme myyjiä kassa-, päivittäistavara ja käyttötavaraosastoille. Myymälän arki on vauhdikasta ja täynnä erilaisia kohtaamisia, ja meille tärkeintä on, että jokainen asiakas lähtee meiltä hyvällä fiiliksellä. Työpäivät koostuvat monipuolisista tehtävistä, kuten asiakaspalvelusta, hyllytystyöstä, esillepanojen rakentamisesta, myymälän siisteydestä huolehtimisesta sekä rahastuksesta. Kaupassa työskentely on fyysistä, sillä liikumme päivän aikana paljon, nostamme ja siirrämme tavaraa ja olemme koko päivän jaloillamme. Prisma Piispanristi palvelee asiakkaita ympäri vuorokauden, ja tehtävä edellyttää valmiutta työskennellä kaupan aukiolojen mukaisesti. Varmistathan, että sinulla on mahdollisuus kulkea toimipaikkaan kaikkina kaupan aukioloaikoina.

Kassaosastolla olet asiakkaan kohtaamisen ytimessä, sillä hyvällä palvelulla teemme asiakkaan päivästä paremman. Asiakaspalvelun lisäksi kassatyössä skannaat ostoksia, käsittelet rahaa ja maksutapahtumia sekä huolehdit kassaosaston siisteydestä. Tämä työ voisi sopia sinulle, jos pidät rutiininomaisesta työskentelystä sekä pystyt säilyttämään rauhallisen otteen myös kiireen keskellä. Perinteisellä kassalla työ painottuu tuotteiden skannaamiseen, rahastamiseen ja maksutapahtumiin. Lisäksi opastamme asiakkaita itsepalvelukassojen sekä kerää ja skannaa -palvelun käytössä ja työskentelemme infopisteellä.

Päivittäistavaraosasto on suurin osasto, ja valikoimaan kuuluvat muun muassa tuoreet hedelmät ja vihannekset, liha-, kala- ja maitotuotteet, valmisruoat, säilykkeet, panimotuotteet ja kosmetiikka. Osastolla huolehditaan, että tuotteet ovat aina saatavilla, tuoreita ja siististi esillä. Päivittäistavaraosastoon kuuluu myös palvelutori, jossa käsitellään tuoreita liha- ja kalatuotteita sekä valmisruokia.

Käyttötavaraosaston valikoimaan kuuluu muun muassa vaatteita ja asusteita, kodin tekstiilejä, elektroniikan sekä urheilu- ja vapaa-ajan tuotteita. Työssä korostuvat esillepanot, tuotteisiin perehtyminen ja asiakkaiden opastaminen. Käyttötavaraosastolle edellytetään kykyä työskennellä eri osastoilla, mutta erityisesti toivomme sinulta kiinnostusta ja ymmärrystä vapaa-ajan tuotteista.

Oletko etsimämme myyjä?

Olet etsimämme myyjä, jos sinulla on positiivinen ja asiakaslähtöinen työskentelyote. Olet oma-aloitteinen tekijä, joka tarttuu reippaasti erilaisiin työtehtäviin ja on valmis työskentelemään joustavasti myös eri osastojen välillä. Arvostamme monipuolista osaamista tai halua kehittyä moniosaajaksi. Lisäksi sinulle sopii fyysinen vuorotyö, jossa työskentelet vaihtelevissa vuoroissa, ja kohtaat satoja ihmisiä päivässä. Eduksi katsomme aiemman työkokemuksen vastaavista työtehtävistä.

Myyjän palkka perustuu Kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen. Tuntipalkka on koulutuksesta ja kokemusvuosista riippuen 10,89-14,57 €/h. Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustepalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1,20 € per tehty työtunti.

Liity meidän porukkaan, niin tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Työpäiviä poikkeuksellisen rennossa porukassa yhdessä Suomen innostavimmassa työpaikassa 😍

  • Mahdollisuuden kerryttää osaamista sekä lisätienestiä tekemällä lisävuoroja muissakin Prismoissa sekä kaikissa TOK:n toimipaikoissa koko Varsinais-Suomen alueella 🤝

  • Kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtävääsi ja mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kasvuun, jota tukevat S-ryhmän monipuoliset oppimis- ja valmennusmahdollisuudet 🤩

Jos ihan tavalliset työt houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan 30.6. mennessä! Me ollaan sinuun yhteydessä sähköpostitse tai puhelimitse 010 764 –alkuisesta numerosta. Kannattaa seurata myös roskapostia, sillä meidän viestit voivat eksyä myös sinne. Kerrothan hakemuksessasi, mistä osastosta olet ensisijaisesti kiinnostunut.

📞 Jos sinulla herää kysyttävää tehtäviin liittyen, tsekkaa yhteystiedot alta:

Prisma-johtajan ja kassaosaston palvelupäällikön Susanna Sakalan tavoitat parhaiten numerosta 010 764 3098 perjantaina 26.6. klo 9-16.

Päivittäistavaraosaston myyntipäällikön Hanna Lempiäisen tavoitat parhaiten numerosta 010 764 4445 arkisin klo 9-15 välillä.

Käyttötavaraosaston myyntipäällikön Anne Hentusen tavoitat parhaiten numerosta 010 764 3120 arkisin klo 9-15 välillä.

Turun Osuuskauppa on osa S-ryhmää ja yksi alueensa suurimmista työllistäjistä. Meillä työskentelet vakaassa organisaatiossa, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi ja rakentamaan entistä parempia asiakaskokemuksia yhdessä ammattilaisten kanssa. Me Turun Osuuskaupassa työskentelemme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei tarkoita, että meillä olisi tylsää tai osaamatonta porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut ja poikkeuksellisen paljon monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia. 82 % työntekijöistämme suositteleekin meitä työpaikkana.
