title: Project Engineer, Complete Vehicle Durability
description:
As part of the Chassis Active Safety and Durability testing team, testing engineer will be responsible to manage testing and development activities as regards to Complete Vehicle Durability.

The role requires someone highly organized, objectively-focused, and with ability to manage their own daily routine.

  • Ensure the correct execution of technical projects.
  • Organize and manage test plan and other aspects of the project.
  • Organize and manage the tests samples (vehicle and test parts).
  • Ensure that test activities (preparation, execution, and analysis) are performed in accordance with the test procedures, test books and Industry standards. To do so, you will be required to develop a deep technical knowledge of test procedures.
  • Oversee project stakeholders and provide instructions, directions, and guidance to ensure optimal execution of their duties.
  • Participate, conduct, and support test activities performed in proving grounds, labs and/or on public roads, when necessary.
  • Collect and analyze the tests data, with specific software and analysis tools.
  • Generate technical report aligned with customers’ expectations and internal quality standards.
  • Maintain efficient and timely communications with your supervisor at all times.
  • Participate in project meetings with customers, suppliers and other relevant parties involved.
  • Manage and enhance communications with customers and other stakeholders.
  • Provide interactive and manual support to mechanical and testing activities, including but not limited to vehicle preparation and driving, when required.
  • Ensure general housekeeping of working (office and workshop) environment.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor or Master’s degree, mainly Mechanical Engineering.
  • Committed, goal driven, with successful result orientation and with strong service orientation
  • Automotive technical knowledge of main vehicle component functions and behavior.
  • Experience with engineering software, data acquisition instrumentation and objective vehicle testing is an asset.
  • Ability to quickly adapt to changes in projects and a continuously evolving industry. Must be able to improvise.
  • Good communication skills and confident in discussions at different hierarchical levels.
  • Must be a team player. Must be able to work within and across various company departments.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must have a flexible schedule and be able to work extended hours. Mandatory overtime and weekends may be required.
  • Willingness to travel (either locally or internationally).
  • Possess a valid driver’s license
  • Must be physically able to support test preparation and execution in an outdoor environment.
  • May require heavy lifting up to 40 lbs.
  • Meet all workplace health and safety requirements and practices.
  • Follow all company policies and procedures.
  • Must be able to stand, bend, kneel, sit for lengthy periods and use hands for various functions such as typing and using various hand tools.
  • Must be able to work from hand-written data sheets and memos.
  • Maintain a clean office area and work environment.

title: Project Manager - Vehicle Durability / Field Operational Test
description:
We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead a large-scale autonomous vehicle testing program across multiple locations in the United States. This role will oversee comprehensive field operational test (FOT) activities involving a substantial fleet of test vehicles equipped with advanced sensor systems for data collection.

The successful candidate will manage all aspects of multi-site operations, including team coordination, vehicle fleet management, route planning, safety compliance, and client relationship management. This position requires strong leadership skills, technical understanding of autonomous vehicle systems, and the ability to manage complex logistics across distributed operations.

The Project Manager will serve as the primary point of contact for client communications, ensuring project deliverables are met on time and within budget while maintaining the highest standards of safety and quality.

The project's success will create potential future opportunities for the Project Manager for business growth in different engineering fields in the United States, with support from international teams from IDIADA Headquarters and other IDIADA Business Units.

Professional Profile

  • Minimum 7 years of project management experience, preferably in automotive, technology, or field operations environments.

  • At least 5 years of experience in field operations management, public road durability testing or automotive testing programs (preferred).

  • Demonstrated experience with ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) or autonomous vehicle testing projects.

  • Proven track record managing multi-site operations with distributed teams across multiple geographic locations.

  • Strong budget management and financial oversight experience, including P&L responsibility (preferred).

  • Experience managing large teams (20+ people) with diverse skill sets and responsibilities.

  • Familiarity with safety protocols, regulatory compliance, and risk management in automotive or testing environments.

  • Valid US driver's license required; willingness to travel across the U.S. up to 30-40% of the time.

  • Experience working with international teams and clients is highly desirable but not required.

Essential Qualities & Competencies

  • Exceptional leadership and people management skills with ability to motivate and develop high-performing teams.

  • Outstanding communication abilities, both written and verbal, with experience presenting to senior leadership.

  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills with ability to make decisions under pressure.

  • High adaptability and flexibility to manage changing priorities in a dynamic operational environment.

  • Technical aptitude with ability to understand and communicate complex autonomous vehicle systems concepts.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with demonstrated ability to build and maintain client relationships.

  • Strong organizational and time management capabilities with attention to detail.

  • Results-oriented mindset with focus on meeting deadlines and achieving project objectives.

  • Collaborative approach with ability to work effectively across different departments and organizations.

  • Passion for automotive technology and commitment to advancing the future of mobility.

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, or related field (required).

  • Master's degree in Engineering, Business, or related discipline (preferred but not required).

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent (highly desirable).

  • Lean Six Sigma certification or similar process improvement credentials (a plus).

  • Equivalent combination of education and extensive relevant experience will be considered.

title: Chassis, Active Safety, Durability Technician
description:
As part of the testing team, technician will be responsible to execute testing and instrumentation activities as regards Chassis, Active Safety and Durability programs. The role requires someone highly organized, objectively-focused, and with ability to manage their own daily routine.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform initial parts set-up including digital pictures, micrometer measurements, visual inspections and parts labeling.
  • Execute vehicle maintenance and component retrofits (brakes, suspension, etc.) in accordance with the preventative maintenance plan and specific testing protocols.
  • Maintain and monitor test facility conditions daily to ensure compliance with accelerated corrosion testing standards. This includes climatic chamber, salt water basin, and mud pit facilities.
  • Execute driving cycles on closed fatigue tracks and public roads in accordance with established testing protocols.
  • Install sensors and data acquisition as required for vehicle tests.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot and repair all defects found during testing.
  • Organize and create labels of tests’ samples using internal SW tools (vehicle and test parts).
  • Transport instrumented test vehicles to the proving ground test facilities (around 120 miles roundtrip).
  • Ensure that test activities are performed in accordance with the test procedures and test books/checklists. Collect and record all data necessary for the completion of the test report.
  • Record when required the videos of the vehicle test maneuvers run in the proving ground with the provided video camera.
  • Report to a Senior Technician or Test Engineer the data generated, progress and status of any tasks deployed

Knowledge/Skills Required:

  • High School Diploma; two-year technical degree or prior trade experience preferred.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a testing environment.
  • Automotive technical knowledge of main vehicle component functions and behavior.
  • Skill in using hand tools (wrenches, sockets), power tools (pneumatic/impact wrenches), and precision instruments like torque wrenches and dial indicators to meet exact manufacturer specifications.
  • Experience with sensors installation, data acquisition instrumentation and objective vehicle testing is an asset.
  • Knowledge of the operation of computers with various software applications including Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to quickly adapt to changes in projects and a continuously evolving industry. Must be able to improvise.
  • Must be a team player. Must be able to work within and across various company departments.

Job Functions:

  • Must be able to stand, walk up and down hills, bend, kneel, sit for lengthy periods, and use hands for various functions such as typing and using various hand tools.
  • Must be able to work in all weather conditions for long periods of time.
  • Must have a flexible schedule and be able to work extended hours. Mandatory overtime and weekends may be required
  • Must be able to lift 40 lbs.
  • Passionate of the automotive world.
  • Willingness to travel and hour adaptability, including weekends.
  • Committed with strong service orientation.
  • Possess a valid California driver’s license
  • Proficient in driving a pickup truck/ vehicle trailer combo (Class C requirements)

Schedule:

  • Monday to Saturday

title: Director, Professional Services - EMEA - London
description:
About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

Role Overview:

The Director is an executive leader responsible for the strategic health and financial performance of the EMEA Services organisation, delivering high-quality professional services that drive customer success with Neo4j. Reporting to the Global VP of Professional Services, you will oversee a multi-layered organisation, providing direction to hands-on Sub-Regional Managers who oversee the day-to-day regional delivery and technical execution of projects and regional staff (Consulting Engineers and Engagement Managers).

Your mission is to build the "Graph Consulting Engine" of the future. You will focus on high-level resource strategy, regional margin optimisation, and fostering a culture of excellence across EMEA. You are managing the business unit that ensures our enterprise customers successfully transition to a relationship-first data paradigm on the cutting edge of Generative AI.

This role balances team leadership, cross-departmental alliance building and strategic customer relationship management to ensure exceptional outcomes and customer satisfaction. Working closely with sales teams and cross-functional stakeholders, the Director plays a pivotal role in the company's growth through service excellence and customer success.

Key Responsibilities:

Organizational Leadership & Strategy:

  • Direct and mentor a team of Sub-Regional Managers, ensuring consistent delivery standards across the hemisphere.
  • Define the long-term regional roadmap for services, aligning headcount growth with Services bookings forecasts and emerging graph use cases (e.g., Knowledge Graphs for GenAI, COEs, etc.).
  • Drive regional "Service Productisation," working with Regional Managers to turn bespoke service engagements into repeatable, scalable service packages.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to turn bespoke graph solutions into repeatable, scalable service offerings.

Financial & Operational Governance:

  • Total P&L accountability for the EMEA region, including revenue attainment, gross margin targets, and organisational utilisation.
    • Regional Revenue Attainment: Achieve or exceed quarterly and annual Professional Services revenue targets for EMEA
    • Gross Margin %: Maintain regional delivery margins by balancing internal headcount costs against billable rates and third-party partner usage.
    • Services Attach Rate: Increase the percentage of software deals that include a strategic services component (Discovery, Architecture, or Implementation).
  • Govern regional capacity planning to ensure Sub-Regional Managers have the headcount and skills (e.g., Cypher, Data Modelling, Agentic Frameworks) to meet demand.
    • Billable Utilisation (Regional Average): Maintain an optimal blended utilisation rate across all sub-regions, ensuring the team is productive without risking burnout.
    • Backlog Conversion Velocity: Monitor the speed at which "Sold" services are converted into "Recognised Revenue" by ensuring Sub-Regional Managers kick off projects promptly.
    • Forecasting Accuracy: Maintain high precision in 90-day revenue and resource forecasting to inform global hiring and capacity decisions.
  • Customer & Platform Impact:
    • Time-to-Value (TTV): Shorten the window between contract signature and the customer’s first successful "Graph Query" or production use case.
    • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT/NPS): Achieve target scores for post-engagement surveys, ensuring high-quality delivery across all sub-regional teams.
    • Renewal & Expansion Rate: Collaborate with Sales/Account Teams to ensure services-led accounts show higher platform retention and expansion into new graph use cases.
  • Organizational Scaling & Talent:
    • Leadership Development: Success in coaching and promoting high-potential individual contributors into management or "Principal Consultant" tracks.
    • Partner Leverage Ratio: Increase the percentage of delivery hours handled by certified Graph Partners to allow internal teams to focus on the most complex, high-margin advisory work.
    • Employee Retention & Engagement: Maintain low voluntary attrition rates across EMEA Services organisation through effective culture-building and career pathing.
  • Risk Management:
    • Oversee regional risk management, acting as the final territory executive escalation point for the most complex or high-risk commercial engagements.

Cross-Functional & Sales Alignment:

  • Partner with the EMEA Sales VP to integrate services strategy into the "Big Deal" motion, ensuring services are positioned as a strategic accelerator, not just a line item.
  • Collaborate with the Partner/Alliances team to build a robust ecosystem of third-party integrators, augmenting internal capacity with certified graph partners.
  • Advocate for the "Voice of the Regional Customer" within the global leadership team to influence the platform’s technical roadmap.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience in Professional Services or Management Consulting within the Enterprise Software/Data space.Manager of Managers: At least 5 years of experience leading a multi-layered organisation with direct responsibility for subordinate people managers. Proven success managing a $5-10M+ P&L in a high-growth SaaS or Database environment.High-level fluency in the Graph Database landscape (NoSQL, RDF, Property Graphs) and an understanding of how graph technology solves enterprise-scale data silos.Experience navigating the complexities of regional expansion, specifically the cultural and legal nuances of operating across EMEA. Ability to design organisational structures and processes that scale beyond individual heroics.Ability to drive consensus across Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams to ensure regional goals are met.Data-driven: Proficiency in using PSA and CRM data to identify trends, forecast revenue, and justify headcount investment.Bachelor’s degree in a technical or business field; MBA highly preferred, given the heavy focus on business operations and P&L management.

  • Experience working with offshore and nearshore partner models
  • Experience creating and leveraging Salesforce/Certinia professional services booking forecasts, resource planners and utilisation reports to analyse regional business.
  • Experience with Gong and Tableau Reporting tools preferred.



Why Join Neo4j?

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

  • Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years.
  • Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.
  • 84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include Boston Scientific, BT Group, Caterpillar, Cisco, Comcast, Department for Education UK, eBay, NBC News, Novo Nordisk, Worldline, and others.
  • Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.
  • Countless industry awards. Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.
  • A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers.

Research shows that members of underrepresented communities are less likely to apply for jobs when they don’t meet all the qualifications. If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we’d encourage you to reconsider and give us the opportunity to review your application. At Neo4j, we are committed to building awareness and helping to improve these issues.

One of our central objectives is to provide an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace for everyone to develop their potential and have a positive, career-defining experience. We look forward to receiving your application.

Neo4j Values:

Neo4j is a Silicon Valley company with a Swedish soul. We foster collaboration and each of us is empowered to contribute and put our innovative stamp on projects. We hire candidates who reflect the following Neo4j core values:

title: Substance Use Practitioner - Maternity cover
description:
Please note that this opportunity is maternity cover, covering a period of up to 10 months.

*This role requires access to a vehicle, and a full current driving licence.

We are looking to recruit a Substance Use Practitioner - Maternity cover in Hampshire, who will work with children and young people to make a positive difference to their lives.

You'll deliver specialist, targeted support to children and young people up to the age of 25, offering confidential and non-judgemental advice and guidance, regarding the use of drugs and alcohol, using a variety of therapeutic interventions.

The work can be challenging, but it is hugely rewarding. The services delivered by our Practitioners has proven to make a real change in the lives of our service users. Last year, 100% were satisfied with our service, 98% felt more able to make positive choices in life, 86% felt that their mental health had improved, and 91% of service users under the age of 18 left the service with a positive outcome (e.g. a reduction in risk, or an improvement in their circumstances).

In addition to the comprehensive training package offered by Catch22, you will also have the opportunity to develop your skills and expertise through a range of additional training, offered by Hampshire County Council. This role also offers the opportunity to build networks and work with a range of partner agencies and commissioners across the substance misuse sector.

Please click here to view the full Job Description

We are looking for people with the following skills and experience:

  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience of working with children and young people with complex needs or vulnerabilities. This could be within substance misuse, children's mental health, children's services, education, pastoral support, or SEN.
  • An ability to build positive and trusting relationships with young people.
  • An adaptable and resilient outlook, able to maintain a commitment to supporting service users

Salary: from £26,097 per annum depending on experience
Hours of work: Full time, 37 hours per week
Contract: Maternity cover for up to 10 months
Location: Our office bases are in Aldershot and Havant, but this role will cover Basingstoke

  • You can work from home/remotely once or twice a week, but this is dependent on service requirements so we are unable to guarantee specific days.
  • You will be based in one of the hubs listed above, but the role will require regular travel across the region, so a driving license and access to a vehicle are required.
  • This role is subject to an Enhanced DBS check.

title: Engineering Manager, Machines4U
description:
What you’ll be doing

  • Own engineering execution for Machines4U, from product development and platform reliability to engineering practices and delivery cadence
  • Translate business priorities set by senior leadership into a clear, sequenced engineering roadmap and deliver against it
  • Lead a high-performing, distributed engineering team, and hold the behavioural and technical bar
  • Partner closely with product and carsales engineering counterparts to shape the Machines4U technology landscape and ensure engineering decisions serve commercial outcomes
  • Lead the progressive modernisation of Machines4U’s technology stack, balancing legacy platform stability with migration to scalable, secure and group-aligned modern systems.
  • Oversee key platform integrations and third-party technical dependencies, ensuring reliable interfaces across marketplace, CRM, payments, marketing, reporting and group systems.
  • Own engineering input into security, reliability and compliance practices, ensuring risks are understood, prioritised and remediated pragmatically.
  • Actively contribute to engineering practices, tooling, and culture across the carsales Engineering community
  • Provide clear, credible engineering perspectives to senior leadership, including assessments of risk, trade-offs, and capacity

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience leading engineering teams in a product-led, commercially-driven environment, ideally in a marketplace or B2B SaaS context
  • Strong technical depth across modern web stacks (backend and frontend), cloud infrastructure, and API design
  • Track record delivering practical engineering roadmaps that move the needle on business outcomes
  • Experience operating in a mixed legacy and modern technology environment, with a pragmatic approach to modernisation and risk reduction.
  • Natural relationship builder who can work effectively across functions, holding your own with stakeholders while staying accountable to a broader group
  • Credible operating range: from coding standards and incident response to roadmap trade-offs and senior leadership updates
  • Hands-on enough to review architecture, unblock engineers, and spot quality problems early
  • Pragmatic experience balancing delivery pace and meeting standards for security, reliability, and scalability

We know not everyone will meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If you’re excited about the role and believe you can make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.

A few other things we want you to know...

  • As an equal opportunity employer, Machines4U and carsales welcomes applications from individuals of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and life experiences. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported.
  • If you have a disability or require adjustments to participate fully in the recruitment process, please let us know - we’re here to support you.
  • We understand the importance of work-life balance and offer flexible working arrangements, including part-time options. If you’d like to explore this, just ask during the process.
  • We’re also a proud Circle Back Initiative employer, which means we commit to responding to every applicant.
  • Successful candidates joining the Machines4U and carsales team will need to complete a National Police Record check and must have full-time Australian working rights.

So come and join our team - because every role is a big role in our plans to go big.

title: Alternance - Contrôleur de gestion Offre circulaire
description:

En collaboration avec le manager de la performance circulaire, tu accompagneras les acteurs à impact dans leur transformation opérationnelle en leur apportant des représentations de la circularité en chiffres et en impact positif carbone

L'alternance chez Boulanger, c'est apprendre et découvrir un métier. Ton audace, ton esprit d'équipe, ta passion seront tes atouts pour t'épanouir chaque jour.

Tu recherches une alternance dans le cadre de ton Master en Finance, Contrôle de Gestion ou Audit.

Au sein d’une entreprise qui place ses clients et ses collaborateurs au centre de ses décisions, tout en portant des engagements forts comme la circularité, rejoins notre collectif et découvre :

title: Associate Director - Performance Improvement
description:
Our Performance Improvement team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Director to join us. This is an excellent opportunity for a candidate with strong consulting capability, ideally complemented by higher education sector experience, who is motivated by solving complex strategic, operational and financial challenges and wants to continue making an impact in the sector.

As an Associate Director, you will work alongside senior leaders and partner closely with clients to design and deliver practical, high-impact solutions. You will contribute across a range of engagements spanning strategic review, operational improvement, financial performance, transformation and implementation. You will bring a commercially minded, problem-solving approach and the ability to work credibly with senior stakeholders in environments where change really matters.

This opportunity will particularly suit candidates who have built their careers in consulting or advisory environments and who value the chance to continue supporting organisations in the higher education sector—bringing together rigour, insight and pragmatism to help institutions respond to financial, operational and strategic pressures.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with clients and colleagues to deliver impactful performance improvement engagements across complex environments.
  • Analyse financial and operational information, identify key issues and develop clear, commercially grounded recommendations.
  • Support clients to better understand business performance, identify opportunities for improvement and navigate change with confidence.
  • Help shape and implement solutions that are practical, sustainable and tailored to each client’s context.
  • Work closely with Partners and senior leaders, contributing meaningfully to both client delivery and broader practice growth.

This role offers the opportunity to combine strategic thinking, commercial analysis and client advisory in a team known for working on high-impact, often business-critical engagements. At KordaMentha, our work is rarely theoretical. We are engaged when organisations need clear thinking, strong judgement and practical action.

For candidates with higher education experience, this is an opportunity to continue applying your sector understanding in a more commercial, advisory-led environment—helping education clients think through sustainability, performance, transformation and strategic direction, while also broadening your exposure across other complex industries.

We are looking for someone who brings a strong consulting toolkit, a commercially curious mindset and the ability to influence outcomes in complex stakeholder environments.

You will have:

  • Relevant tertiary qualifications and approximately 6–8 years’ experience, including time in professional services or consulting.
  • Strong experience diagnosing and solving complex commercial, operational or financial issues.
  • Excellent analytical capability, including financial analysis, modelling and/or report development.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and influence stakeholders effectively.
  • A genuine interest in how organisations operate and how performance can be improved in practical, measurable ways.
  • Experience in or exposure to the higher education sector will be highly regarded, particularly where coupled with consulting, transformation or strategic advisory work.

KordaMentha — Build your future, shape ours

We don’t just hire talent; we invest in it - with support that accelerates your success in every way.

Why Join Us?

  • Professional Development: Expert mentorship, tailored training via KordaMentha Business School, study support, and our Accelerate program for Analysts to Associate Directors — build your brand, expand your network, and gain strategic insights from senior leaders
  • Flexibility: We champion work/life integration with options that fit your lifestyle.
  • Career Growth: Merit-based promotions, secondments, and opportunities to work alongside senior leaders on impactful projects.
  • Leave That Works for You: Buy extra leave and access volunteer, generous parental leave and career break options.
  • Culture & Connection: Social events, cultural celebrations, and our bi-ennial black-tie ball.
  • Family Support: Flexible parental leave, return-to-work support through our partner GracePapers, and resources for every stage of family life.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Inclusive wellness initiatives and confidential and industry leading EAP for you and your family.
    \n
    \nThis isn’t just a job — it’s a place where your ambitions are nurtured, your wellbeing is valued, and your contributions celebrated. Ready to shape your future with us?

Recruitment and Search Firms:

While your interest is appreciated, KordaMentha does not take responsibility or accept charges for unsolicited approaches.

At KordaMentha, we believe there is strength in difference. Our entrepreneurial spirit expands the possibilities for action. We approach situations, challenges, and opportunities with optimism, curiosity, and diversity of thought. We seek novel solutions to problems and encourage unconventional and innovative approaches.

Our team's diverse skillsets, backgrounds and experiences fuel KordaMentha's different mindset. Our selection process values diverse perspectives and considers each applicant's unique strengths and capabilities.

title: Shift Lead
description:
JOB PURPOSE

To handle shift operation, Shift team handling (involved direct workers & contract workers including mobile equipment operators.)

Plant operational control and safety observation to ensure zero harm during operations.

EHS :

  • Respect all safety rules as per HARSCO standards and work should be as per Procedures.
  • Must obey the customer and Harsco safety rules and policies
  • Ensure Participation in all the company safety event.
  • Shouldn’t allow anyone to work unsafe manner
  • Ensure to know the all aspects and impacts of your workplace prior to each task and to protect environment as per company standard.
  • Ensure to execute all best practices at work by provide training.
  • Ensure tool box talk before start shift operations/ maintenance activities.
  • If any incident happens, must report immediately to the site safety officer and site manager including his reporting Manager.
  • Adequate training for EHS and Job specific training to the direct workers.

Financial:

  • Shift leading and production in the shift i.e. Revenue of the plant in a shift
  • Mobile equipment effective utilization with proper plan
  • Accountable for shift operations of: Ferrochrome Plant.
  • Material dispatch, Feeding and trucking certification for the shift operations.

Non-Financial:

  • Safe work practices implementation and worker discipline to be maintained.
  • Shift lead must ensure for Zero-Harm policy for safety-Environment-wealth-health while carrying plant operations.
  • Shift in-charge shall ensure for all activities follow thru as per SOPs instruction.
  • Must ensure pre-start check list to follow.
  • Toolbox talk before start shift operations/ Maintenance activities.
  • Must ensure for quality of product and accountable for quality product.
  • Direct workers supervision in the shift
  • Site supervision during shift including site assets.
  • Authorized to issue work permit to maintenance activities in absence of maintenance manager/concern personnel.
  • Must ensure competent personnel to attend the maintenance activities.
  • Mobile plant operators and equipment supervision and work distribution
  • Work force utilization plan
  • Coordination with customer area owner during shift operations to get dispatch plan.
  • Slag pit supervision and slag handling monitoring to ensure slag dumping in designated locations.
  • Shift in-charge must ensure for all safe practices and all staff should obey the company code of conduct.
  • Shift lead must report to operations manager on each shift operations
  • Must maintain the logbook properly with all information.
  • Observations during shift operations should be share with the team to rectify the problems and fix the benefits to the plant operations.
  • Shift lead must follow the company cardinal rules and company best practices.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Safe working practices for the team/ accountable for any safety violations.
  • Operations/Maintenance and supervision of plant operations during the shift
  • Quality of the product
  • Shift team management
  • Confidentiality of Valuable plant information.
  • Equipment condition and fault identification during operations to report to immediate manager.

Qualifications:

  • Education
    • B.Tech Mechanical Engineering
    • Diploma Engineers
    • Add-on Qualification on Safety is an advantage.
  • Experience
    • 5 years of relevant experience in Steel / Cement / Ferrochrome / Any Process Plant Operation in JIGGING.
    • Proficient in English, Hindi Language.
  • Shift handling and quality& Quantity of production target to achieve the given figures.
  • Mobile equipment planning to maintain site operations at optimum production cost.

Job Purpose:
\nPlanner/Scheduler position is responsible for the effective execution of all maintenance work control processes. He is responsible to the Maintenance Manager for the efficient and effective use of planning and scheduling all resources to conduct maintenance activities which result in minimum downtime and maximum productivity. In order to fulfill these responsibilities in the most effective manner, the Planner/Schedule is empowered to manage work priority, develop job plans, define parts and material, define crafts and skills and engage the proper resources to develop a safe, effective and efficient work control plan. In addition, the Planner/Scheduler provides the equipment-related expertise and technical guidance on improving Preventive Maintenance activities.

Responsibilities

  • Planner/Scheduler once a valid work request is submitted will prioritize, plan, schedule and follow –up on accuracy of the job plan for all planned work. There focus is not day to day but is to be proactive and optimize workforce productivity and minimize plant downtime by managing work 2 weeks to 1 month in advance. In performance of these duties the planner/scheduler has the following responsibilities:
  • Principle contact and liaison between the maintenance department and operation planning. They ensure the area, department or facility in which they are assigned receive professional maintenance service in a timely manner to ensure high equipment availability and performance.
  • Review all planned work request from assigned area and determine validity and accuracy of information and engage the appropriate resources to set a preliminary priority. (Note; emergency work orders are not processed by planner/schedulers)
  • Reviews work request for accuracy and clarity: clear scope of work, realistic completion date, proper lead times, correct equipment identification, proper charge number (if applicable), proper authorization, and discuss details with originator of the work order.
  • Review the work to be performed and determine the best way to accomplish the work. They will consult with Leads, Supervisors, Originator, Production Supervisors, Planner/Schedule and Stores as necessary.
  • Identifies and secures all parts and material required to complete the work 9) Work with Stores to manage spare part usage to maximize turns but minimize risk of using critical spares.
  • Approach all aspect of the work being performed with safety as the highest priority.
  • Provide job estimates based on craft or skills required, sequence required and number required.
  • Provide a total cost estimate for the work to be performed: labor, material, and outside services.( by automatically oracle)
  • Manage the status of work control and backlog for work order submission to work order completion. Status may include: waiting for planning, waiting parts, ready to schedule, scheduled, etc.
  • Verifies all material, information, tools and Labor are available prior to scheduling.
  • Develops a preliminary workforce schedule by crew ensuring all skills requirement and resource availability is met orders, optimum downtime windows, and necessary lead times.
  • Finalize the Maintenance resource schedule based on agreed plan with production.
  • Follow up and communicates schedule to all resources: maintenance, production, and stores .
  • Issue scheduled work orders with job plan packets to supervisors.

Relationships

  • Reports to Maintenance Manager.
  • Works closely with Operation supervision
  • Works closely with Maintenance Leads and Supervisors.
  • Works closely with Stores and purchasing personnel.
    \n

Education

  • A bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Mechanical Department

Experience

  • 2 years minimum experience in a heavy equipment field;

Technical Skills

  • Competent presentation skills include using Company preferred IT programs including PowerPoint, Excel and Word.

Other Skills

  • Must be fluent in written and spoken Arabic.
  • Good command of English (writing & speaking)
  • The ability to work with minimum supervision and use initiative;
  • Must demonstrate the highest levels of personal and business integrity at all times.

Disclaimer

title: Supplier Quality Engineer
description:
Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) is responsible for ensuring that suppliers meet the company’s quality standards and requirements by working with the Global Supply Chain and Global Engineering Departments in the assessment and development of the strategic global supply chain. The Supplier Quality Engineer role involves evaluating, monitoring, and improving supplier performance through audits, inspections, and collaboration. The Supplier Quality Engineer provides strong, demonstrated leadership to quickly manage supplier-related issues and drive continual improvements in global supplier performance.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, procurement, and manufacturing to ensure alignment on quality expectations and standards. Liaison between product engineers, manufacturing, and vendors.
  • Supplier Evaluation: Leads, or participates in cross functional supplier validation audits, quality assessments, and supplier manufacturing capability studies. Review supplier processes, adherence to processes, and process improvement.
  • Quality Assurance: Develop and implement quality control processes for incoming materials, components, and assemblies.
  • Problem Solving: Conduct onsite supplier visits for root cause analysis and verification of corrective action plans.
  • Performance Monitoring: Track and report supplier performance metrics, including defect rates, delivery timelines, and compliance to required certifications.
  • Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of supplier quality assessments, audits, and performance reviews.
  • Continuous Improvement: Support, Lead, and Drive initiatives to improve supplier quality, reduce defects, and enhance overall supplier performance. Responsible for the proper use of quality tools and methods, such as DOE, RCCA, 8D, MSA, FAI, sampling plans, process capability analysis, FTA and SPC to help resolve supplier quality issues in an efficient and effective manner.
  1. Education
  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher (completed and verified from start) in a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (DTEM) or related discipline from an accredited institution.
  1. Experience
  • A minimum of 5+ years in Quality Engineering, Supplier Quality Engineering, or Supplier Quality Management within an industrial manufacturing environment (automotive, heavy equipment or heavy custom “make to order” industries).
  • Strong knowledge of quality management systems (ISO 9001)
  • Strong knowledge of welding (AWS and EN)
  • Excellent data analytics and reporting skills
  • Experience with supplier audits and assessments
  1. Other Requirements
  • Ability to travel internationally and domestically
  1. Interpersonal Skills
  • Ability to effectively communicate verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a diverse cross functional global environment.
  • Ability to effectively plan and organize.
  • Strong judgment skills – must be able to make decisions with little guidance.
  1. Technical Skills
  • Proficient with MS Office, ERP systems, Data analytics
  • Proficient with quality tools and methodologies (A3, 8D, Sig Sigma)
  • Ability to read, analyze, communicate, and interpret technical data/drawings.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Six Sigma Greenbelt or higher
  • ASQ CQE certification

IV. Essential Functions

  • The ability to effectively work in a culturally diverse global team environment.

title: Shift Lead
description:
JOB PURPOSE

To handle shift operation, Shift team handling (involved direct workers & contract workers including mobile equipment operators.)

Plant operational control and safety observation to ensure zero harm during operations.

EHS :

  • Respect all safety rules as per HARSCO standards and work should be as per Procedures.
  • Must obey the customer and Harsco safety rules and policies
  • Ensure Participation in all the company safety event.
  • Shouldn’t allow anyone to work unsafe manner
  • Ensure to know the all aspects and impacts of your workplace prior to each task and to protect environment as per company standard.
  • Ensure to execute all best practices at work by provide training.
  • Ensure tool box talk before start shift operations/ maintenance activities.
  • If any incident happens, must report immediately to the site safety officer and site manager including his reporting Manager.
  • Adequate training for EHS and Job specific training to the direct workers.

Financial:

  • Shift leading and production in the shift i.e. Revenue of the plant in a shift
  • Mobile equipment effective utilization with proper plan
  • Accountable for shift operations of: Ferrochrome Plant.
  • Material dispatch, Feeding and trucking certification for the shift operations.

Non-Financial:

  • Safe work practices implementation and worker discipline to be maintained.
  • Shift lead must ensure for Zero-Harm policy for safety-Environment-wealth-health while carrying plant operations.
  • Shift in-charge shall ensure for all activities follow thru as per SOPs instruction.
  • Must ensure pre-start check list to follow.
  • Toolbox talk before start shift operations/ Maintenance activities.
  • Must ensure for quality of product and accountable for quality product.
  • Direct workers supervision in the shift
  • Site supervision during shift including site assets.
  • Authorized to issue work permit to maintenance activities in absence of maintenance manager/concern personnel.
  • Must ensure competent personnel to attend the maintenance activities.
  • Mobile plant operators and equipment supervision and work distribution
  • Work force utilization plan
  • Coordination with customer area owner during shift operations to get dispatch plan.
  • Slag pit supervision and slag handling monitoring to ensure slag dumping in designated locations.
  • Shift in-charge must ensure for all safe practices and all staff should obey the company code of conduct.
  • Shift lead must report to operations manager on each shift operations
  • Must maintain the logbook properly with all information.
  • Observations during shift operations should be share with the team to rectify the problems and fix the benefits to the plant operations.
  • Shift lead must follow the company cardinal rules and company best practices.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Safe working practices for the team/ accountable for any safety violations.
  • Operations/Maintenance and supervision of plant operations during the shift
  • Quality of the product
  • Shift team management
  • Confidentiality of Valuable plant information.
  • Equipment condition and fault identification during operations to report to immediate manager.

Qualifications:

  • Education
    • B.Tech Mechanical Engineering
    • Diploma Engineers
    • Add-on Qualification on Safety is an advantage.
  • Experience
    • 5 years of relevant experience in Steel / Cement / Ferrochrome / Any Process Plant Operation in JIGGING.
    • Proficient in English, Hindi Language.
  • Shift handling and quality& Quantity of production target to achieve the given figures.
  • Mobile equipment planning to maintain site operations at optimum production cost.

title: MANTENEDOR INDUSTRIAL I
description:
Operar a Planta Separadora, na área da Unidade, para processamento e seleção do material de acordo com suas especificações.Controlar funcionamento das correias e peneiras de classificação, regulando a entrada e saída de material, para evitar obstrução das mesmas e paradas do processo produtivo. Fazer testes de teor metálico para atestar a qualidade do F1 e 3 a 8". Fazer limpeza dos equipamentos, retirando materiais agarrados.Preencher relatório diário, anotando os dados do equipamento, número de horas trabalhadas e atividades realizadas, para acompanhar o estado de conservação do equipamento e necessidade de manutenção. Inspecionar o equipamento diariamente, checando funcionamento dos roletes, estado das correias, estruturas de shutts e bicas, raspadores e instalação elétrica (visualmente sem nenhum contato ou aproximação) a fim de assegurar o seu eficiente funcionamento. Zelar pela limpeza e conservação das ferramentas e equipamentos utilizados, limpando e guardando em lugar apropriado para tê-los, em permanente condições de uso, bem como da limpeza e conservação das áreas da Unidade e de seu local de trabalho; Utilizar EPI (Equipamento de Proteção Individual), bem como observar, zelar e cumprir as normas de segurança da empresa, para sua segurança pessoal e demais funcionários da empresa
Executar soldas com eletrodo revestido, soldas por adição e fusão, cortes com eletrodos e cortes oxi-acetilênicos. Executar soldas especiais, tais como: Mig, Mag,Tig , metalizado/ plasma e arcos submersos, ajustando o equipamento e os materiais para o tipo de serviço, garantindo a não fadiga/ ruptura. Preparar peças para soldagem. Manter as máquinas de solda e aparelhos oxicorte em condições de uso adequado.
Executar serviços de manutenção mecânica de acordo com especificações técnicas dos manuais de serviços dos equipamentos, planos de manutenção e procedimentos operacionais da empresa. Remover e instalar componentes dos equipamentos. Proceder desmontagem, reparo/revisão e montagem de componentes. Levantar e controlar dados para a manutenção. Preencher corretamente a ordem de serviço, repassando-a para o PCM, ao final do mesmo.
Fazer pintura e conservação de equipamentos e estruturas prediais da Harsco.
Executar outras atividades correlatas e de mesma complexidade com às acima descritas, à critério de seu Superior.

title: EH&S Safety Officer
description:
I. Position Summary and Primary Responsibilities:

The position is charged with the assistant of the Environment, Health and Safety function on a single site within Egypt with responsibility to provide support to the EH&S ’Manager in order to enable the function to achieve local, Regional and Corporate objectives and targets.

The position is also charged with the responsibility of overseeing operator training to ensure that it meets the required standards to ensure the health and safety of our colleagues, and that Company EH&S training requirements for managers and supervisors are successfully implemented.

The job holder will be responsible for ensuring the effective execution of the fatality prevention and framework assessment programs and all other EH&S programs within their area of responsibility.

II. Required Education and Qualification.

Education:

  • A bachelor’s degree of Science or Engineering

Experience

  • 2 years minimum experience in a heavy industrial environment;
  • Competent knowledge of legislation pertinent to EH&S within Egypt

Other Requirements

  • Detailed knowledge of steel industry working practices, including industry standards and Global Best Practices.
  • Detailed knowledge of heavy plant operation
  • Detailed knowledge of operating practices at all sites within their area of responsibility;
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both written and spoken English;
  • The job holder will be required to represent the Company at customer meetings.
  • High level of cultural awareness for the indigenous peoples of Egypt

Preferred Experience

  • Executing, maintaining accreditations and auditing to ISO9001, ISO14001 and OHSAS 18001 or national equivalent.
  • Lead accident investigator
  • Experience of a process orientated investigation system.
  • Proven ability to interpret data and produce site level reports
  • Environmental management awareness to national standards.
  • Ability to effectively present information and respond to verbal & written questions
  • Employment exposure to an overseas based International Company

Interpersonal Skills

  • Ability to develop and manage effective internal and external relationships;
  • Ability to share knowledge and circulate good practice within ROW.
  • Must be a team player and be able to actively participate in team EH&S meetings and programs.

Technical Skills

  • Competent presentation skills including use of Company preferred IT programs including PowerPoint, Excel and Word;
  • Proficiency in the use of the electronic incident notification system such as EMEX, MYOSH or INS.

Other Skills

  • Must be fluent in written and spoken Arabic.
  • The ability to work with minimum supervision and use initiative;
  • Must be flexible and be able to travel as required to Dubai and within Egypt
  • Must demonstrate the highest levels of personal and business integrity at all times;
  • Ability to liaise with any government, state or federal agencies in relation to EH&S on behalf of the business.

title: MECANICO I
description:
Estamos à procura de um Mecânico I eficiente e orientado para os detalhes para se juntar à nossa equipa em Ouro Branco, Brasil. Como Mecânico I, você será responsável por realizar manutenção de rotina, reparos e inspeções em vários sistemas mecânicos e equipamentos.

  • Realize inspeções regulares e manutenção preventiva em equipamentos mecânicos
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas mecânicos utilizando ferramentas e equipamentos de diagnóstico
  • Efetuar reparações em motores, transmissões, sistemas hidráulicos e outros componentes mecânicos
  • Manter registos precisos de reparações, actividades de manutenção e utilização de peças
  • Assegure sempre o cumprimento dos protocolos e procedimentos de segurança
  • Colaborar com os membros da equipa para concluir tarefas de reparação complexas de forma eficiente
  • Mantenha uma área de trabalho limpa e organizada
  • Responda a chamadas de reparação de emergência, conforme necessário
  • Diploma do ensino secundário ou equivalente
  • 1-3 anos de experiência em mecânica automóvel ou industrial
  • Proficiência em técnicas de reparação e manutenção mecânica
  • Experiência na utilização de equipamento de diagnóstico e interpretação de resultados
  • Aptidões na utilização de ferramentas manuais e eléctricas
  • Conhecimentos básicos de informática para manutenção de registos e documentação
  • Conhecimento de vários sistemas mecânicos, incluindo motores, transmissões e sistemas hidráulicos
  • Conhecimento dos protocolos e procedimentos de segurança num ambiente de trabalho mecânico
  • Carta de condução válida
  • Formação profissional em mecânica (preferencial)
  • Capacidade de ler e interpretar manuais técnicos e esquemas
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e de análise
  • Excelente atenção aos pormenores e capacidade de organização
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários flexíveis, incluindo noites e fins-de-semana, quando necessário
  • Capacidade física para levantar equipamento pesado e trabalhar em várias posições
  • Capacidade de comunicação efectiva em português e conhecimentos básicos de inglês

title: MACARIQUEIRO I
description:
• Executar a inspeção de pré-uso dos equipamentos de corte; preparar o maçarico de corte ou lança de corte, verificar as condições das mangueiras, conexões, e manômetros de pressão dos gases; acende o equipamento de corte; verificar o fluxo dos gases; efetuar o corte da sucata;

  • Inspecionar e controlar a descarga de sucatas na área de oxi-corte de sucatas, e determinar o local correto de descarga dos materiais;

  • Verificar se há cilindros ou vasos herméticos, tais como: vasos fechados, garrafas de oxigênio, acetileno, argônio e etc;

  • Verificar se há sucatas contaminadas com produtos químicos, hidrocarbonetos e outros contaminantes tais como: matérias com graxas/óleo, latas de tintas, borracha, madeira, plástico e principalmente sucatas com resíduos de coqueira, por questões de segurança e evitar acidentes;

  • Aceitar matérias para corte, tais como: bobinas, chapas, estruturas metálicas, trilhos, vigas etc (se as mesmas estiverem limpas;

  • Zelar pela limpeza e conservação das ferramentas e equipamentos utilizados, limpando-os e guardando-os em lugar apropriado para tê-los, em permanente condições de uso, bem como da limpeza e conservação das áreas da Unidade e de seu local de trabalho;

  • Comunicar ao superior imediato, os desvios de meio ambiente e de saúde e segurança observados, seja ou não relacionado à sua atividade;

  • Executar outras atividades correlatas e de mesma complexidade com às acima descritas, à critério de sua Superior.

Ensino Fundamental Completo;

Experiência comprovada em CTPS

Hast Du Spaß daran, Sachen zum Laufen zu bringen und teils knifflige Herausforderungen zu lösen? Bist Du ein wahrer Troubleshooter und hast gute Ideen Probleme nachhaltig zu beseitigen?

Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Wir suchen nach einem Inbetriebnahme-Techniker mit Affinität für Projektmanagement (m/w/d), der Lust hat, unser Team in Brandenburg zu verstärken und ein Teil davon zu werden.

Als Inbetriebnahme-Techniker (m/w/d) sind Deine Aufgaben:

  • Terminplanung, -steuerung und -kontrolle der notwendigen Aktivitäten sowie Gegenmaßnahmen bei Verzögerungen der Inbetriebnahme von Harsco Fahrzeugen
  • Federführend in den Prüf- und Inbetriebnahmearbeiten an elektrischen, elektromechanischen und elektronischen Ausrüstungen entsprechend vorgegebenen Prüfprotokollen, welche du mit erstellst
  • Du kümmerst Dich selbständig um die Fehlersuche und -behebung (elektrisch und mechanisch) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team
  • Die Durchführung von elektrischen Messungen, insbesondere Isolationsprüfungen, Erdwiderstands- und Busmessungen, ist ebenso Deine Aufgabe
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen sollte vorhanden sein
  • Koordination, Beratung, Schnittstellenmanagement mit relevanten internen und externen Partnern (Lieferanten, Kunden) sowie Behörden
  • Das Wichtigste ist, dass Du Lust hast auf eine wirklich interessante Aufgabe und die Möglichkeit Dich ständig weiterzuentwickeln
  • Eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik oder Mechatronik ist ein Muss für diese Position. Außerdem ist eine abgeschlossene Weiterbildung zum Industriemeister Elektrotechnik, Techniker (m/w/d) oder vergleichbares von Vorteil aber kein Muss
  • MS Office Kenntnisse hast Du im Gepäck
  • Erfahrung in der Inbetriebsetzung von Schienenfahrzeugen
  • Du bist teamfähig, engagiert, motiviert, verantwortungsbewusst und beherrschst die deutsche Sprache sicher. Gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

title: Marketing Video & Motion Artist
description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

Primary focus

The Marketing Video & Motion Artist handles the full video production pipeline, from in game capture to creating engaging marketing videos, trailers, social media content and user acquisition ads for different platforms, including Microsoft Store, Steam, PlayStation, Nintendo, Xbox, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and other performance channels.

The goal is to create polished, dynamic and effective video content that attracts players, supports the game brand and encourages users to download or engage with our games.

What it means on a daily basis

Production

  • Create high quality video content to support marketing, social media and user acquisition needs.
  • Manage the full video production process, including brief analysis, concept development, and delivery of the finished asset.
  • Capture engaging in game footage directly from Unreal Engine or game build, with attention to camera work, composition, readability and emotion.
  • Edit videos with a clear sense of rhythm, storytelling, pacing, and platform-specific expectations.
  • Create polished motion graphics to support the clarity, polish, and professional finish of each video.
  • Design and animate title cards, end cards, text treatments, callouts, transitions, logo animations, graphic overlays and other motion elements.
  • Adapt videos into multiple formats and aspect ratios, ensuring optimization for different platforms and distribution channels.
  • Enhance overall video quality by incorporating sound effects, music, text, graphics, motion design and other visual elements.

Communication

  • Incorporate client feedback (lead/internal teams/licensor) and ensure revisions are completed on spec and on time.
  • Respond promptly to stakeholder feedback from groups such as marketing, legal, and licensing, and make sure the final deliverable meets requirements.
  • Participate in meetings and consistently contribute fresh, creative ideas.
  • Provide input into the creative direction for video content, shaping the overall narrative and tone of marketing videos.

Consistency & Guidelines

  • Learn and adhere to artistic, IP, and licensing guidelines.
  • Ensure brand consistency across all video materials, maintaining a cohesive visual and narrative style across campaigns and platforms.

Organization & Reporting

  • Use Airtable to track assigned requests, update production status, share delivery links and maintain clear visibility on project progress.
  • Monitor the performance of video ads and collaborate with internal teams to improve results by providing insights and recommendations.

Innovation

  • Use creativity and innovation to propose new ideas and formats to elevate video production.
  • Offer creative suggestions for video projects, focusing on visual storytelling, pacing, and overall design.
  • Keep up with trends in gaming and video platforms, applying relevant innovations to content creation.

Who you would be working with

You will be working closely with the Creative Agency Team Lead and other Graphic Designers.

Your recruitment journey

(1) Screening call with HR

(2) Test

(3) Interview with Hiring Manager

(4) Offer

Our selection process is skill-based, focuses strictly on technical proficiency and core skills.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

  • Solid video editing skills, solid motion design capability and in game capture.
  • Solid understanding of motion design and animation principles, including timing, rhythm, typography, composition, transitions and visual hierarchy.
  • Capability to oversee the full creative workflow, from preparing assets to delivering the final product, while staying aligned with the creative brief.
  • Can proficiently work in After Effects, Premiere, photoshop including effects such as Red Giant Suite. Illustrator and InDesign.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Refined artistic sensibilities, attention to detail, and a focus on constantly innovating and exploring new techniques.
  • Skill in handling several priorities at once while meeting competing deadlines in an active workplace.
  • A willingness to learn about game-engine content manipulation using the Unreal Engine.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

Benefits

  • Permanent contract, full-time job with comprehensive Social Benefits.
  • A flexible work model that supports work–life balance.
  • Ongoing learning and development opportunities to support career growth.
  • Private health insurance and fitness subsidies.
  • Access to employee mental health and wellbeing support.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Childcare assistance.
  • Additional paid leave, including: Birthday leave, Christmas shutdown leave, Volunteer leave, Women’s health leave.
  • An employee referral program with generous bonuses.
  • Subsidised car parking.
  • A dedicated relaxation space, including a massage chair.
  • Free coffee from a commercial espresso machine, plus daily snacks and a light breakfast.
  • Friday social drinks with friendly game tournaments.
  • A stunning rooftop terrace with river views and a games room.
  • Exclusive Gameloft-branded merchandise.
  • Our studio mascot — Mr Hendricks, the friendly Dachshund who proudly guards the studio.

Life at Gameloft

Since 2014, our Brisbane Studio has grown into a full-service, end-to-end studio. We create world-class, multi-award-winning titles such as The Oregon Trail™, My Little Pony: Mane Merge, and more recently, Carmen Sandiego.

As pioneers in Brisbane’s game development landscape, we craft immersive experiences that transcend traditional boundaries and engage players across diverse platforms. We are proud to be developing Bluey’s Happy Snaps, bringing one of Australia’s most iconic IPs to life in a brand-new interactive experience. As we venture into this exciting phase, we’re also expanding our talented team for a range of unannounced projects.

Gameloft Brisbane is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering diversity and inclusivity within our work environment.

Driven by a strong studio culture and a passion for creating meaningful experiences, we build games that resonate with players around the world.

How to proceed

Ready to level up your career? Click I'm interested/Apply and send us your updated CV and portfolio in English!

title: Program Manager – Infrastructure & OT Security
description:
We are seeking an experienced Program Manager – Infrastructure & OT Security to lead a critical global initiative focused on IT/OT separation, Operational Technology (OT) security enhancement, and infrastructure transformation.

This role will be responsible for driving the implementation of a new global OT domain, overseeing the migration of OT applications, and ensuring the successful delivery of a complex, business-critical security program. The successful candidate will work across multiple teams, suppliers, and stakeholders in a matrix environment while supporting the organization's strategic OT security objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate the implementation of a new global OT domain to support IT/OT separation requirements.
  • Project manage the transition of OT applications into the new OT environment, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including SMEs, Infrastructure teams, Security teams, 3rd Line Support, and external suppliers.
  • Operate effectively within a matrix project management environment, managing competing priorities and varying delivery timelines.
  • Provide regular status updates, risk assessments, and progress reporting to the central program office and Global Program Lead.
  • Drive improvements in OT security, authentication, and authorization controls across operational environments.
  • Support initiatives to increase resilience and stability by reducing dependencies on legacy and End-of-Life (EOL) systems.
  • Enable centralized management of OT user accounts and resources, including integration with enterprise Identity and Access Management solutions such as MyAccess IAM.
  • Ensure effective governance, budget management, resource planning, and program reporting throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Identify and manage risks, issues, dependencies, and change requests across the program.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience delivering large-scale Infrastructure, Cyber Security, or OT transformation programs.
  • Strong understanding of Operational Technology (OT) environments and associated security challenges.
  • Experience managing IT/OT separation initiatives, infrastructure migrations, or domain transformation programs.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects in a global matrix organization.
  • Experience coordinating technical teams, SMEs, managed service providers, and third-party vendors.
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, Identity & Access Management (IAM), and security governance frameworks.
  • Understanding of OT security principles, network segmentation, resilience planning, and legacy system remediation.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and reporting skills.
  • Strong budget management, governance, and program control experience.
  • Familiarity with project management methodologies such as PRINCE2, PMP, Agile, or equivalent.

Desirable

  • Experience with OT security frameworks (IEC 62443, NIST, ISA/IEC standards).
  • Knowledge of industrial environments such as manufacturing, energy, utilities, or critical infrastructure.
  • Experience implementing IAM integrations within OT environments.
  • Security or project management certifications.

title: Cutover Manager - SAP Implementations
description:
We are seeking an experienced Cutover Manager to join our team at a leading foreign pharmaceutical company in Tokyo, Japan. The Cutover Manager will be responsible for planning, managing, and executing the cutover phase of system implementations, ensuring a seamless transition from legacy systems to the new solution. This role will work closely with project managers, business stakeholders, IT teams, and other key departments to ensure all cutover activities are completed on time, within scope, and with minimal disruption to ongoing operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end cutover planning and execution for major SAP and IT system implementations, ensuring a smooth transition with minimal business disruption.
  • Own and maintain the comprehensive cutover plan, including detailed tasks, milestones, dependencies, timelines, and clear alignment with all impacted stakeholders across business and IT.
  • Align and integrate business and IT cutover activities, including defining responsibilities, coordinating execution, and ensuring readiness across all teams.
  • Drive business readiness and continuity planning, including market supply measures (e.g., pipeline filling, stockpiling), as well as business ramp-down and ramp-up plans aligned with local senior management.
  • Coordinate and lead cutover rehearsals to validate plans, identify risks, and ensure all stakeholders are fully prepared for execution.
  • Oversee data migration and system readiness, ensuring integrity, completeness, accuracy, and that all configurations, testing, and validation activities are completed prior to go-live.
  • Manage cutover execution globally, leading cutover calls and governance forums, tracking progress, and ensuring successful delivery of all planned activities.
  • Act as escalation point for cutover issues, proactively managing risks, resolving problems, and ensuring timely mitigation actions.
  • Facilitate communication and reporting, providing clear, structured updates and status reports to project teams, stakeholders, and the Deployment Management Team (DMT).
  • Ensure user and business readiness, including completion of training and readiness activities prior to go-live.
  • Lead go-live, hypercare, and stabilization phases, including hypercare execution meetings, ramp-up tracking, and ensuring smooth transition to steady-state operations.
  • Support project management during cutover, ensuring alignment with overall program delivery and timelines.
  • Develop and maintain cutover documentation, including checklists, runbooks, and reporting artifacts, in compliance with regulatory and industry standards (especially within the pharmaceutical sector).
  • Lead and guide cutover team members, providing direction and support to ensure effective planning and execution.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Pharmacy, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Cutover Manager or in a lead/senior project management role with 5+ years of experience managing cutover and transition activities, particularly in SAP or other enterprise systems.
  • Strong knowledge of cutover processes, data migration, and go-live activities in the context of large-scale IT implementations.
  • Fluent in English and Japanese (spoken and written).
  • Experience with SAP implementations (e.g., S/4HANA, ECC) or similar enterprise solutions.
  • Expertise in risk management and the ability to mitigate potential issues during the cutover process.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth project execution.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills to address issues that may arise during the cutover phase.
  • Excellent communication, coordination, and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical industry regulations (GxP) and compliance standards is a plus.
  • PMP, PRINCE2, or similar project management certification is preferred.

Offered benefits
\n

  • Great package: We provide a competitive salary and benefits package, along with an outstanding work environment that fosters long-term career development opportunities.
  • People Focus: Unite with the best global talent in life sciences, empowered to grow and collaborate in a vibrant environment.
  • Truly Global: Join a truly global organization where mutual support, teamwork, and diversity drive our collective success.
  • Grow Your Skills: Join regular workshops, academies and trainings - inhouse workshops und trainings (optional)
  • Invest in Your Learning: Access CHF 1,500 (approx. 280k JPY) annually for professional development

Corporate culture and work life balance
\n

  • Flat hierarchies: Speak your mind and grow with close mentoring by senior leaders
  • Remote workstyle: Work from anywhere in Japan (if client project allows)
  • Working location: Temp office in Shinbashi
  • Work flex: Enjoy 25 days of flexibility to work from your preferred global location (under client’s permission)
  • Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance, with flexibility beyond standard holiday allowances.

title: MES Solution Architect – PharmaSuite (m/f/d)
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled MES Solution Architect with proven experience in MES platforms within the pharmaceutical industry, ideally FactoryTalk PharmaSuite (Rockwell Automation), to drive the design, development, and implementation of manufacturing execution solutions. In this critical role, you will act as a technical leader, working closely with clients to ensure seamless integration between MES and enterprise/shop-floor systems. You will lead standardization initiatives, guide recipe design, and help build scalable delivery capabilities within a highly regulated pharmaceutical environment.

What you will be doing:

  • Lead the creation of Process Requirement Specifications (PRS) and the overall design of MES recipes.
  • Drive standardization and harmonization through reusable MES templates, libraries, and best practices.
  • Design and implement integrations between MES and key adjacent systems, including SAP, LIMS, and DCS.
  • Define MES solution architecture and data flows across manufacturing and enterprise landscapes.
  • Support the growth of the MES delivery team by identifying required capabilities and facilitating knowledge transfer.
  • Mentor client and project teams to build long-term MES expertise and operational readiness.
  • Coordinate and guide German-speaking MES recipe authors and support teams to ensure high-quality solution delivery.
  • Technical Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience and architectural knowledge in PharmaSuite or other MES in the life science industries.
  • System Integration: Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing interfaces between MES and enterprise/shop-floor systems, with strong working knowledge of SAP, LIMS, and DCS.
  • Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, QA documentation, and testing frameworks.
  • Regulatory Fluency: Strong working knowledge of critical industry standards: GxP, GAMP etc.
  • Language Skills: Fluent German is strictly required for collaborating with MES recipe authors and personnel, alongside professional proficiency in English.
  • Leadership Capabilities: Demonstrated ability to mentor teams, transfer knowledge effectively, and scale resources dynamically based on project needs.
  • Hybrid On-Site: On-site presence is required at least from Tuesday to Thursday to ensure highly collaborative MES recipe development, testing, and team alignment.

You’ll work alongside experienced consultants on complex, meaningful projects that demand both precision and innovation. Our culture emphasizes continuous learning, open knowledge sharing, and cross-functional teamwork—empowering you to grow both professionally and personally.

  • Encourages entrepreneurial thinking, empowering you to take initiative, solve problems, and lead change.
